title: Senior Software Engineer I
description:
### **The Opportunity**

This role is an opportunity to build high-quality, scalable software that directly enables real-world infrastructure deployment across telecom, energy, utilities, and renewables. You will work in a modern engineering organization where craftsmanship, velocity, user empathy, and technical maturity are valued. Success will be measured by the quality of code, as well as collaboration, communication, understanding customer use-cases, and uplifting engineering excellence.

### **What You’ll Do**

As a Senior Software Engineer I, you will design and implement end-to-end features by partnering with Product, QA, and DevOps to translate complex requirements into implementation plans and maintainable code. You would architect scalable solutions by designing and building performant, reusable Apex and LWC components, focusing on advanced asynchronous patterns and state management, lead complex integrations by overseeing the design and execution of inbound and outbound integrations, drive engineering excellence by drafting Technical Design Documents (TDD), breaking down technical specifications, and advocating for architectural improvements.

You will optimize performance by focusing on database query performance and indexing to ensure the platform handles increasing loads efficiently. You would ensure quality and customer impact by building software that supports diverse user personas and real-world usage patterns, while leveraging AI tools for refinement and deliver with autonomy by managing project scope independently, providing accurate effort estimations, and maintaining a commitment to meeting deadlines.

### **The Skills You’ll Have**

#### **Technical Expertise & Architecture**

* Designs and builds complex, performant, and reusable Apex/LWC components that manage state and interact with external system
* Deep experience designing and executing both inbound and outbound integrations.
* Apex Mastery: Implements advanced async patterns (Queueable, Platform Events) and consistently writes reusable, efficient, and thoroughly tested Apex
* Proficient in Git version control, managing pull requests, and executing standard CI/CD deployment processes
* Understands modern design patterns and best-practice development approaches
* Writes extensible, test-friendly code
* Advocates for architectural improvements that benefit scalability and maintainability
* Experience utilizing AI coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude) to accelerate code scaffolding and refactoring, while maintaining strict code quality and security standards
* Understands how their component fits into the larger system
* Approaches debugging analytically, identifying issues across multiple layers
* Recognises knowledge gaps and actively seeks learning

#### **Quality & Customer Focus**

* Learns the “why” behind requirements and user scenarios.
* Builds software that supports real-world usage patterns including offline and low-connectivity environments
* Writes code that reduces downstream testing risk and future defects
* Thinks empathetically about multiple product personas

#### **Work Management**

* Strong commitment to meet the delivery deadlines
* High autonomy in managing project scope
* Handling competing architectural priorities across multiple projects
* Helps drive clarity during technical discussions and team execution
* Sets a collaborative tone rooted in humility and shared learning

#### **Communication & Influence**

* Communicates clearly, frequently and successfully in both written and verbal formats
* Adapts style based on audience both technical or business
* Able to present work and demo functionality to groups
* Communicates well in both in-person and remote environments.

### **Within 90 Days, You’ll**

* Become an expert in the functionality and codebase of several modules across the Sitetracker product
* Complete your Development Plan and be fully ramped on our technology stack and established design patterns
* Be a consulted contributor as part of one of our delivery teams
* Deliver several enhancements and bug fixes
* Know the ins and outs of the Sitetracker product offering as well as how to build and extend the functionality
* Begin working with other senior developers to architect solutions for our customers
* Know the development best practices and begin to help junior developers with questions about development practices
* Work with junior and senior developers to perform code reviews that follow Sitetracker coding standards
* Work with your manager to learn our deployment process

### **Within 180 Days, You'll**

* Have built and shipped large modules
* Serve as a technical expert for modules and features built during requirement and design sessions
* Collaborate with external teams to debug issues raised by customers
* Volunteer on initiatives that advanced Sitetracker’s developer efficiency and best practices
* Use your expertise to identify technical debt and deliver an action plan to resolve it
* Take part in customers meetings to gather requirements, understand use cases, and be able to explain your solutions in a simplified non technical way
* Architect End-to-End Solutions
* Written clean, scalable code with solutions that results in features adopted and loved by customers
* Serve as subject matter export to other teams for features that you have developed

### **Within 365 Days, You'll**

* Mentor junior and mid-level developers on development practices
* Drive efficiencies in the team by being an advocate for process/coding standard improvement
* Define standards for new technologies
* Develop large scale modules in a generic way so that we can extend and enhance the Sitetracker offering
* Lead engineering initiatives within the team that are focused on continuous improvement or leveraging new technology that significantly enhances efficiency, quality, or the user experience
* Develop strong industry expertise in the industries we serve to better inform the software you develop
* Serve as a primary subject matter expert for other teams in several areas of the application that you were not directly a part of
* Have established strong bonds with your team members that ensures efficient completion and building of features that our customers love

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Desktop Application Developer (C++)
description:
**Company Description**

Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,500 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 25+ million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.

#LI-Hybrid

 **Job Description**

We are looking for a **Senior Desktop Application Developer** to be part of the team designing, architecting, and implementing our AI-powered IT self-service chat agent — a native desktop application distributed to 20+ million endpoints worldwide. This client is the face of Nexthink’s AI platform, giving employees a seamless, responsive experience directly on their Windows and macOS devices.

As a Desktop Engineer, you will go beyond implementation: you will set technical direction for the client layer, influence cross-team design decisions, and serve as a trusted advisor to both engineering leadership and product. You’ll tackle problems of performance, reliability, and native OS integration while partnering with backend, infra, and security teams to ship a production-grade application at global scale.

This is a high-impact, high-ownership role where you’ll make foundational architectural decisions about the client platform and help shape the desktop engineering practice at Nexthink.

Responsibilities

* Define and drive technical vision and architectural strategy for the desktop client application.
* Lead design of a high-performance, native desktop application running on Windows and macOS at 20M+ endpoints.
* Partner with product, backend, and AI/ML teams to align the client experience with the broader AI platform.
* Provide technical leadership on client architecture, coding standards, and best practices for native desktop development.
* Architect and deliver a reliable, secure application covering the full distribution lifecycle: signing, packaging, installation, updates, and uninstallation.
* Champion observability, crash reporting, performance monitoring, and diagnostics across the client stack.
* Act as a mentor and multiplier, raising the technical bar and helping engineers grow.
* Lead technical deep dives, design reviews, and roadmap alignment discussions with leadership.
* Ensure security, compliance, and OS-level integration best practices are embedded in design from day one.

 **Qualifications**

* 7+ years of desktop application engineering experience, shipping native applications on Windows and macOS.
* Proven success designing and shipping client applications to large user bases, with a deep understanding of platform-specific constraints and behaviours.
* Strong proficiency in C++, with solid experience building cross-platform desktop applications.
* Deep knowledge of Windows and macOS OS APIs.
* Hands-on experience with the full application distribution lifecycle: code signing, packaging, auto-update mechanisms, and deployment at scale.
* Strong understanding of desktop application performance profiling, memory management, and crash diagnostics.
* Exceptional communication skills — able to influence cross-functional teams and leadership with clear technical direction.
* Track record of mentoring and elevating engineering teams.

Nice to Have

* Familiarity with Rust and the Tauri framework.
* Familiarity with React and TypeScript UI development.
* Experience integrating desktop clients with cloud backends via REST, WebSockets, or gRPC.
* Background in system-level programming: OS hooks, accessibility APIs, inter-process communication.
* Prior work on applications with silent background processes, system tray agents, or notification-driven UX.
* Experience with endpoint telemetry, observability SDKs, or APM integration on the client side.
* Experience with enterprise software distribution and managing application update strategies at scale.

 **Additional Information**

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1200 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Check what we offer:

* Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.
* Health insurance through our partnership with Bajaj, including OPD coverage for dental, vision, health check-ups, consultations, and pharmacy expenses.
* Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work, with a structured approach for new hires to foster connections and onboarding.
* ️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 22 days of holidays we offer). Plus, company-paid bank holidays (12), sick days (10-30), bereavement leave (5), and 3 days per year for volunteering.
* Free access to professional training platforms to explore your interests and enhance your skills.
* ️ Stay covered against accidents, bodily injuries, and disabilities with our personal accident insurance policy, providing assurance with coverage up to three times your annual CTC.
* New mothers are entitled to up to 26 weeks of maternity leave, with the flexibility to use up to 8 weeks before the expected delivery and the remaining 18 weeks after. Birth fathers can take 6 weeks of paternity leave, while adoptive parents are eligible for 26 weeks of leave for mothers and 6 weeks for fathers.
* Under the Payment of Gratuity Act, receive gratuity at the rate of 15 days of basic pay for every completed year of service, provided you've been employed by the company for a minimum of 5 years. Gratuity is payable at retirement or resignation based on your last drawn basic pay.
* Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.

description:

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Job Description
  
Are you interested in working on a mobile product that is a mission-critical part of field service delivery to some of the world’s largest companies and a growing base of hundreds of thousands of users? We aim to transform the field service industry by empowering our customer workforce with mobile-first, offline-first, extensible apps that help them work more efficiently. Our fast growing applications are used by hundreds of thousands of mobile workers around the world. Each mobile worker depends on our product to deliver excellent service in even the most remote areas across a wide variety of industries. We are looking for talented engineers to join our growing team.
  
Our engineers are always learning new things and looking to improve our products and also the way we deliver our products. We pride ourselves on writing high-quality code and maintainable systems that make our lives easier across the technology stack. Every engineer works on exciting, meaningful projects that impact our technical and product strategy. We work closely with every team member to ensure they have a career path that suits their interests and passions and offers maximum impact for our customers.
  
We’re building a team of talented and thoughtful people who will work together to build an enduring business that will change the way people in the field deliver service.
  
What we look for:
  
  
Total years of experience between 6-8 years
  
Experience writing Kotlin and Java for Android.
  
Proven ability to bring mobile software to market (having an app available in the App Store for which you were a key contributor is a big plus).
  
Expertise and interest in designing, building, and maintaining features and libraries on Android.
  
Excel in a collaborative, remote-first, team environment.
  
Proven ability to learn quickly and implement unfamiliar technologies
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  
Have a strong quality mindset and deliver features on time with high quality.
  
Experience with C++ or Android is a plus.
  
Proven ability to navigate large enterprise environments as part of a global team
  
Self-motivated and innovative problem solver.
  
Positive attitude and focused on continuously improving the team, the product, and the company.
  
  
What you’ll do:
  
  
You’ll use a blend of Kotlin & JetPack Compose and some Java to develop high-quality software that delights our customers.
  
Test and automate to ensure robust, high-quality software in each release.
  
Work in a highly collaborative team environment with some incredibly talented developers, solving challenging problems and helping eliminate obstacles as they appear.
  
Assist our user experience team in designing innovative and highly usable mobile interfaces.

title: Senior Assigned Support Engineer-(Designated / Premier Support)
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.*

**An overview of this role**
----------------------------

As an Assigned Support Engineer, you’ll be a trusted technical advisor to GitLab’s largest Self-managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com customers, helping them avoid operational disruption and get the most from GitLab. You’ll combine deep Linux systems expertise, GitLab and CI/CD knowledge, and a proactive support mindset to understand each customer’s environment, anticipate and prevent issues, and solve complex technical and business challenges. In a typical week, you might be prioritizing strategic blockers with customer stakeholders, partnering with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales to drive defect resolution and influence the roadmap, or diving into code, logs, and tools like strace to troubleshoot performance issues. Your impact in the first year will be measured by customer trust, reduced critical incidents, and clear, reusable support content that empowers customers and GitLab teams alike.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Provide technical support to our largest Self-managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com customers, ensuring their GitLab environments remain stable and performant.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex, critical, and sensitive support issues using tools like Zendesk, logs, and Linux utilities such as strace, through email and video conferencing.
* Build strong, proactive relationships with key customer stakeholders, helping them prioritize and address their most important technical blockers.
* Collaborate with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales teams to drive bug fixes, influence feature development, and help shape product goals and roadmap.
* Act as a technical expert on GitLab and CI/CD implementations, advising customers on how incidents and service interruptions impact their workflows and how to mitigate them.
* Create and improve support content, including documentation and knowledge articles, to help customers and GitLab team members resolve issues more efficiently.
* Partner closely with Support Engineering team members through pairing sessions and stable counterpart relationships to share knowledge and solve problems together.
* Contribute to team growth by participating in hiring processes, including reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* Background managing complex, customer facing support cases end to end, from initial inquiry and triage through reproduction, escalation, and resolution.
* Advanced troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate ambiguous, multi-layered technical issues and identify root causes across applications, infrastructure, and integrations.
* Strong Linux systems administration knowledge (LFCE or RHCE equivalent), including performance analysis and low-level debugging tools.
* Practical experience with GitLab and continuous integration / continuous delivery (CI/CD), including how different deployment models and outages affect customers.
* Ability to write and maintain clear, reusable support content such as knowledge articles, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides.
* Proficiency with scripting languages (such as Ruby or Bash) and familiarity with model-view-controller (MVC) frameworks, preferably Ruby on Rails.
* Effective communication skills for explaining complex technical topics to audiences with varying technical backgrounds and for building rapport with customer stakeholders.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and serverless platforms, with openness to applying transferable skills from related domains.

**About the team**
------------------

The Support team is a fully distributed, global group across the AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions, focused on helping customers get the most from GitLab by troubleshooting complex issues and digging into code and logs to understand why something is not working as expected. As an Assigned Support Engineer, you’ll be part of our broader Support Engineering organization, working closely with other Support Engineers through regular pairing sessions, 1:1s, coffee chats, and Slack conversations to stay connected while collaborating asynchronously across time zones. We balance autonomy with accountability, giving you flexibility to structure your shift in a way that fits your life while ensuring we can reliably address customer issues. Thanks to GitLab’s Transparency value, you can see what we are working on in our Support Team page. Additionally, you can see our company roadmap and meetings to see what we are working on at any time.

#### **How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

**Country Hiring Guidelines:** GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

**Privacy Policy:** Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. title: Manager, Software Development Engineering
description:

The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. **About the Team**

As a Manager, Software Development Engineering in DT (Deployment Technology), you will lead a team that designs and builds scalable tools to help customers move their data and configuration objects into Workday environments with confidence. You'll combine technical leadership, people management, and product-focused thinking to deliver modern platform capabilities that simplify deployment, improve adoption, and create a better implementation experience. Your team's work directly helps customers realize value from Workday more quickly.

**About the Role**

You will lead engineering teams working across multiple programming languages, technologies, and platforms, guiding the delivery of high-quality software that supports customer deployments and configuration movement across Workday environments.

  

**Team leadership**

* Mentor and develop your engineers, support their career growth, and build a positive, inclusive, high-performing team
* Hire and retain strong talent, set clear expectations, and give regular, honest feedback
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and accountability

**Delivery and operational excellence**

* Align technical execution with business priorities, and give your team the clarity, direction, and support to deliver
* Plan and deliver complex technical initiatives by ensuring requirements are well understood, risks are managed, and dependencies are coordinated
* Own the reliability, performance, and supportability of your team's services in production, including incident response and continuous improvement
* Hold your team to high standards for quality, predictable delivery, and operational readiness
* Plan capacity and priorities so your team can deliver sustainably

**Stakeholder partnership and communication**

* Partner with engineering, product, customer success, and implementation teams to define priorities and shape the roadmap
* Influence architectural and technical decisions, and build alignment across teams
* Communicate proactively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, surfacing progress, risks, and trade-offs early rather than waiting to be asked

**About You**

* 3+ years of experience building and directly managing engineering teams
* 8+ years of software development experience building cloud-based applications in an object-oriented language such as Java, Python, C#, or C++
* Experience owning delivery and production operations for software services, in partnership with product and other cross-functional teams
* Bachelor's degree in a computer-related field, or equivalent work experience

  
Other Qualifications:

* You see software development as a team sport and thrive in a collaborative, agile culture where you're always guiding and learning
* You focus on delivering high-quality software and continuous innovation, and you value performance engineering
* You're proactive and deliver on the initiatives you start
* You have the interpersonal skills to positively influence important decisions in a multi-functional environment
* You communicate technical complexity in simple terms to technical and non-technical audiences
* You have experience supporting team members' career growth and development
You put people first and ensure a psychologically safe environment for your team  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Relay Yard Automation, Relay Yard Automation
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon moves millions of packages daily through a global logistics network of Fulfillment Centers, Sort Centers, and Delivery Stations. Every facility has a trailer yard — the physical space where line-haul vehicles arrive, get loaded or unloaded, and depart. Tracking what's happening in these yards in real time (which trailers are where, what state they're in, who's arriving and departing) is a hard problem that sits at the intersection of physical operations and software systems.  
  
The Relay Yard Automation (RYA) team builds the software that manages these trailer yards across 6,000+ Amazon facilities on three continents. Our products handle 200K+ gate transactions  
per day and facilitated the arrival and departure of 55M vehicles last year. We integrate computer vision, RFID, GPS, ultrasonic sensors, and IoT edge devices to automate what were historically manual, associate-staffed processes, from gate check-in/check-out to in-yard trailer movements. Our gate automation program has already eliminated millions of manual transactions, with a long-term goal of fully autonomous yard operations.  
  
The tech stack is diverse by necessity: Android mobile apps for yard associates and drivers, React web applications for remote gate agents and yard operators, Java/TypeScript backend services on AWS, and hardware integrations running on edge compute devices deployed in the field. Systems are loosely coupled, event-driven, and must operate reliably in environments ranging from 1M+ sq ft North American fulfillment centers to small urban European delivery stations.  
  
As an SDE on this team, you will design and build features and services that power yard automation across Amazon's logistics network. You will write high-quality code across the full stack, contribute to system design discussions, and deliver projects from technical design through production launch. The role involves working across backend services, web and mobile applications, and integrations with physical sensor systems at the edge. You will make thoughtful engineering trade-offs, participate in design and code reviews, and contribute to the team's operational excellence practices — supporting tier-1 systems where your work directly impacts driver experience and Amazon's ability to meet customer delivery promises.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement software for yard and gate automation products across tier-1 systems. Your code runs in production where defects directly impact driver experience and customer delivery promises.

  

* Lead large projects end-to-end: define the technical approach in ambiguous problem spaces, decompose work into parallel workstreams, and deliver cohesive launches.

  

* Own system architecture for your team's services. Proactively simplify code, resolve architecture deficiencies, and remove bottlenecks across Java backend services, TypeScript/React web apps, Android mobile apps, and IoT edge devices.

  

* Make short-term vs. long-term trade-off decisions and communicate them clearly to your team and stakeholders.

  

* Integrate with physical systems — RFID readers, computer vision cameras, ultrasonic sensors, GPS — running on edge compute in variable warehouse environments. Debug problems that span hardware and cloud software.

  

* Own operational excellence for services you build: monitoring, alarming, runbooks, incident response, and root-cause corrective actions.

  

* Influence technical direction beyond your team through design reviews with partner teams across Transportation Technology.

  

* Act as a force multiplier. Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design artifacts, and reusable frameworks. Mentor junior engineers toward their next level.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Our platforms and services are trusted by 1,000+ clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL and the Board of Control for Cricket India (BCCI).[RB1] We’re 1,000+ people across 15 offices.

Skills can be learned. Attitude and the ability to learn quickly matter most in this team, especially as AI changes how we build software.

Discover why Couchbase is trusted to help the world's biggest players scale, move fast and stay resilient, no matter what's next on their roadmap. Visit couchbase.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.  
  
Want to be part of our story? Apply today!

**About the role**
------------------

Couchbase is hiring a Salesforce Developer with 3–5 years of experience to build and maintain the CRM platform that runs our lead-to-cash process. You will join the Business Applications team and deliver development across Sales Cloud, Salesforce CPQ, and a busy set of integrations with finance, marketing and revenue tools.

Our org has been live since well before 2018 and carries a mix of Apex, Flows, legacy Process Builder and approval-process automation. A large part of this role is helping modernise that automation safely while delivering new features for Sales, Deal Desk, Finance and Professional Services, with guidance from senior team members.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, build and test Apex classes, triggers, batch and scheduled jobs, and Lightning Web Components to well-documented standards.
* Build and maintain record-triggered and scheduled Flows, and migrate legacy Process Builder, Workflow Rules and approval-process logic to Flow.
* Extend Salesforce CPQ: product and price rules, quote templates, custom quote line logic, Advanced Approvals and the quote-to-order handoff.
* Support document generation and e-signature flows in Conga Composer and DocuSign.
* Build and troubleshoot integrations with NetSuite, Certinia PSA, Clari, Marketo, LeanData, ZoomInfo and others, working with our Workato and Celigo recipes and Salesforce REST, Bulk and Platform Event APIs.
* Implement data-model changes on Opportunity, Account and related objects, including picklists, multi-select fields, record types, validation rules and rollups, with reporting impact in mind.
* Maintain record locking, sharing, profiles, permission sets and permission set groups, keeping access least-privilege.
* Deploy changes through sandboxes via changesets, DevOps Center, following our source control, code review and rollback practices.
* Keep Apex test coverage and quality high, and monitor errors, governor limits and integration failures.
* Translate requests from Sales, Deal Desk, Finance, Marketing and PS into technical designs, estimates and documentation.
* Review Salesforce's three releases a year and managed-package upgrades for impact on our customisations.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 3–5 years of hands-on Salesforce development, with at least 2 years on Sales Cloud.
* Solid Apex (triggers, async Apex, batch, queueable) and SOQL, with a good understanding of governor limits and bulkification.
* Strong Flow skills; experience migrating Process Builder or Workflow Rules to Flow is a plus.
* Hands-on Salesforce CPQ experience (price rules, product rules, quote templates), at least 1 year preferred.
* Integration experience with REST APIs and Named Credentials; will be good to have
* Working knowledge of the security model: profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, approval processes and record locking.
* Owning solutioning end to end, from development to testing to deployment
* Clear written communication; able to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
* Salesforce Platform Developer I certification.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience with Salesforce CPQ Advanced Approvals
* Background in Quote-to-Cash architecture
* Experience with Custom Metadata Types, Platform Events, and Event-Driven Architectures
* Salesforce certifications (e.g. Platform Developer II, CPQ Specialist)
* Exposure to Einstein Activity Capture
* Exposure on Salesforce integration to Claude, Gemini via MCP servers

**Working at Couchbase**

At Couchbase, innovation thrives when diverse perspectives come together. Our culture is driven by **four core values** that guide how we build mission-critical technology and collaborate every day:

  

* **Put the Customer First:** The customer must be at the center of everything we do.
* **Be a Good Human, Always:** Integrity, empathy, and respect are our non-negotiable bedrock.
* **Win as One Team:** No one wins alone. Collaboration is how we erase silos.

**A note on qualifications:** Studies show that underrepresented talent is less likely to apply unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If you are excited about this role and feel you can make strong contributions to our team, **please apply**—even if your experience doesn't check every single box.

*If you require reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let your recruiter know. We are happy to support you.*

  

**Why Couchbase?**

Modern customer experiences demand a flexible cloud database platform that powers applications from the cloud to the edge and everywhere in between. Couchbase's mission is to simplify how developers and architects build, deploy, and consume modern applications. With **Capella**—our fast, flexible, and affordable cloud database platform—we enable organizations to deliver premium user experiences backed by best-in-class price performance.

  

More than **30% of the Fortune 100** trust Couchbase to power their mission-critical applications. We're also proud to be consistently recognized as a **Best Place to Work** in both the Bay Area and the UK.

  
**What We Offer (Total Rewards)**

We offer a holistic approach to benefits that recognizes the value you create, helping you care for yourself and your family:

  

* **Generous Time Off:** Flexible programs designed to support your work-life balance.
* **Health & Wellness:** World-class medical, dental, vision, mental health, life insurance, and employee assistance programs.\*
* **Financial Security:** Competitive retirement plans\* and business travel coverage.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Join an impact initiative group and experience the amazing feeling of Couchbase can-do culture.

title: Sr Software Engineer - Engineer
description:
**About the role and team**  
  
At Uber, AI agents are increasingly writing, reviewing, testing, and debugging code in production. They deliver high-quality results efficiently, without wasting tokens, only when they understand Uber's codebases. The AI Context Engineering team builds the context foundation that every software-development AI agent at Uber relies on:  

* AI Context Graph: a unified graph of services, ownership, domain entities, and business flows
* Code Graph: a graph representation of Uber's monorepos built for agents to consume
* AI-Generated Documentation: documentation that stays fresh as code changes
* Agentic Memory: a memory layer that lets agents learn across sessions

  
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own major parts of this platform end to end. You'll take them from prototype to production at monorepo scale, and work with partner teams to integrate foundational context products with the agents running in production for workflows such as root-cause analysis, code authoring, test planning, and library upgrades, etc  
  
**What will you do**  

* **Context Graph and Ontology:** Enrich the graph with new entity types, such as data streams, metrics, and observability signals, and link them to code so agents can reason across systems.
* **Code Graph Infrastructure:** Build and scale code graphs across multiple monorepos and microrepos, covering symbols, call edges, dependencies, and links between code and tests. Add incremental updates, versioned (historical) graphs, and function-level embeddings, and serve the graphs to agents with low latency through local and remote interfaces.
* **AI-Generated Documentation:** Extend automated documentation from backend services to mobile (screens, UI components), libraries, and data pipelines. Use refresh strategies that keep context current as code changes.
* **Agentic Memory:** Design the memory layer that lets agents persist and reuse decisions, past fixes, and team preferences across sessions.
* **Standards and Governance:** Define and roll out standards for agent instruction files (AGENTS.md), including structure, content, and token budget, and generate them systematically across modules.
* **Context Quality Evaluation:** Build continuous evals that measure the accuracy and freshness of every context product, and run A/B experiments that prove the impact on agent outcomes.
* **Tooling and Integration:** Build MCP servers, skills, and tools that deliver context to agents. Partner with AI Platform, Developer Experience, and product teams to integrate them into production workflows.
* **Technical Leadership:** Drive design reviews, mentor engineers, and turn ambiguous problems into well-scoped, measurable projects

  
**What will you need**  

* **Experience:** 8+ years of software engineering experience building production systems, with a degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Programming:** Strong in Go, Java, or Python, writing clean, well-tested, maintainable code.
* **LLMs and Agentic Systems:** Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agents, including prompt and context design, tool use, and retrieval, and a good sense of what context makes agents succeed or fail.
* **Code Understanding:** Experience with static analysis, ASTs, parsers such as tree-sitter, or build and dependency systems in large codebases.
* **Data at Scale:** Experience building reliable data pipelines and working with graph or other large-scale data stores.
* **Emerging Protocols:** Familiarity with MCP and agent-to-agent protocols and how to apply them.
* **Problem Solving:** Strong analytical skills and a habit of measuring outcomes, not just shipping features.

  
**Success Metrics**  

* More agentic workflows use curated context in production, with a measured improvement in each workflow's business metric, such as accuracy, cost, latency, or CI time.
* Agents provide higher-quality, better-grounded answers while using fewer tokens and tool calls than when they rediscover context from scratch.
* Context coverage grows across languages, repos, and entity types, with measurable accuracy and freshness.

  
**Bonus Points If you have**  

* **Graph Databases:** Experience with Neo4j or similar graph databases, including query optimization and schema design.
* **Embeddings and RAG:** Experience with embedding generation, vector databases, and retrieval pipelines.
* **Evaluation:** Experience designing LLM evals, LLM-as-judge methods, or A/B experiments for AI systems.
* **Developer Platforms:** Experience in developer tooling, CI, or monorepo infrastructure.
* **Observability:** Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Langfuse, or similar tools for monitoring AI systems.

  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

description:

At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

**Your opportunity**

  

At New Relic, we provide our customers real-time insights, so they can innovate faster. Our software delivers insightful observability tools across different technologies and distributed systems, enabling software engineering teams to quickly identify, understand and tackle issues, analyze performance and get the most of their software and infrastructure.

The Integrations Platform team owns New Relic's GitHub, GitHub Enterprise and ServiceNow integrations. These integrations bring third-party data into New Relic as entities, relationships and events, and power Service Architecture Intelligence (repository and team catalogs, service maps and scorecards) as well as New Relic's AI and agentic experiences.

As the Lead Software Engineer, you will set the technical direction for our new integrations platform, shared building blocks for authentication, data retrieval, webhooks, data processing, rate limiting, remediation, reconciliation, etc., that let us deliver a new integration in weeks instead of quarters. You will be the team's most senior engineer, leading by example in the collaboration, mentorship, ownership and accountability.

**What you'll do**

  

* Build a scalable platform that brings in data from dozens of integrations from thousands of customers.
* Define and drive the technical roadmap and architecture of the Integrations Platform, ensuring high availability, resilience, and operational excellence.
* Lead the design and development of reliable, event-driven Java services on Kafka and Kubernetes that ingest and synchronize data from third-party systems such as GitHub, GitHub Enterprise and ServiceNow without data loss.
* Own large, multi-engineer projects end to end, from design documents and decision records through to general availability, while staying hands-on with production code and code reviews.
* Act as the team's senior technical expert, mentoring engineers and establishing standards for code quality, testing, security, and performance.
* Own the operational health of the team's services, including observability, alerting, SLOs, on-call, and incident response, and eliminate systemic issues such as API rate limits, retry storms, and out-of-order webhook events.
* Collaborate with product management, architects, partner teams, and customers to translate business requirements into scalable technical strategies.
* Evaluate and introduce new tools and practices for the team, including AI-assisted and spec-driven development.

**This role requires:**

  

* **Experience:** 10+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years as the technical lead of a team or major initiative, designing and building large-scale distributed systems.
* **Advanced Java Engineering:** Expert-level proficiency in Java and modern backend frameworks (Spring Boot, or similar), with strong knowledge of concurrency, REST API design, and JVM performance.
* **Event-Driven Systems:** Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka (or similar).
* **Cloud Architecture:** Hands-on experience running services in the cloud, preferably AWS, with strong working knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, and observability.
* **System Design:** Exceptional problem-solving skills with a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, resilient microservices design, relational data modeling, and SQL.
* **Technical Leadership:** Proven track record of defining technical vision, mentoring engineers, and successfully leading the delivery of mission-critical systems.
* **Collaborate** with cross-functional leadership to translate complex business requirements into highly scalable technical strategies.
* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to engineers, product managers, and customers.

**Good to have skills:**

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

**About** **the** **Team**

The NR Lens team builds New Relic's Federated Data Platform — a distributed SQL query engine that lets customers connect external data sources (Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Google Sheets, AWS CloudWatch) and query them directly from New Relic.

You'll work on the distributed query execution layer, connector architecture, and API gateway that powers cross-source JOINs and unified analytics across customer data stores.

**What** **You'll** **Do**

* Design, build, and maintain cloud-native Java microservices in the NR Lens query path: SQL Gateway, Query Gateway, and data source connector plugins
* Develop and harden JDBC connector integrations — including connection lifecycle management, credential handling, query pushdown optimization, and security validation
* Improve query reliability and performance across a multi-tenant distributed SQL deployment serving 50+ customers
* Build and operate services on AWS (EKS, IAM/STS, S3) with infrastructure-as-code practices
* Implement security controls for user-supplied connection parameters (JDBC URL validation, SSRF prevention, hostname allowlisting)
* Build materialized view scheduling, execution, and lifecycle management features
* Design and implement deployment automation — canary deployments, progressive rollouts, observability integration
* Collaborate with the NRDB/Dirac team on the internal connector bridging federated queries to New Relic's native telemetry engine
* Participate in on-call rotation and incident response for production systems

**What** **We're** **Looking** **For**

**Must** **Have:**

* 5+ years of professional Java development .
* Strong experience building cloud-native applications on AWS.
* Experience designing and operating containerized microservices on Kubernetes
* Experience building and operating distributed systems at scale
* Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience with AWS security patterns.
* Experience with observability tooling — defining SLOs/SLIs, dashboards, alerting
* Comfort debugging production issues across multi-service architectures
* Experience with gRPC or Thrift-based service communication
* Experience with GraphQL APIs

**Nice** **to** **Have:**

* Strong understanding of SQL query execution — parsing, planning, optimization, or execution engines
* Experience with JDBC drivers, connection pooling, and database connector development
* Experience with distributed query engines or SQL-on-anything platforms
* Experience developing plugins or connectors for distributed query engines (SPI-based architectures)
* Knowledge of RBAC/authorization systems in multi-tenant SaaS environments

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

title: Software Test Engineer
description:
**Entity:**

Technology  

**Job Family Group:**

Research & Technology Group  

**Job Description:**

**Who we are**
--------------

  
  

**About bp/team**
=================

bp technology is the central organization for all software and platform development. We build all the technology that powers bp’s businesses, from upstream energy production to downstream energy delivery to our customers. We have a variety of teams depending on your areas of interest, including infrastructure and backend services through to customer-facing web and native applications. We encourage our teams to adapt quickly by using native AWS and Azure services, including serverless, and enable them to pick the best technology for a given problem. This is meant to empower our software and platform engineers while allowing them to learn and develop themselves.

  
  

**Role Purpose**
================

The Software Test Engineer is responsible for assuring the quality, reliability and usability of digital platforms and services supporting the Corporate Affairs portfolio. The role combines hands-on manual testing with test automation to validate that new features, integrations, fixes and releases meet business, user, technical and operational requirements.

  
  

Working closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Technical Delivery Leads, Software Engineers, suppliers and business stakeholders, the role embeds quality throughout the delivery lifecycle. It plans and implements functional and non-functional testing, builds reusable automated tests, manages defects and provides clear evidence to support release decisions and continuous improvement.

  
  

**Scope & Scale**
=================

**Platform focus**

Supports Corporate Affairs digital platforms and services, including DCP, Brand Portal, global web, content, campaign, analytics, integrations and operational support capabilities.

**Testing coverage**

Covers manual and automated functional, integration, regression, API, end-to-end, smoke, exploratory and release testing.

**Non-functional quality**

Supports accessibility, usability, cross-browser, responsive, performance, security and operational-readiness validation.

**Delivery lifecycle**

Contributes from discovery and requirements refinement through build, test, release, production verification and post-release improvement.

**Quality engineering**

Builds reusable automation, quality gates, test evidence, defect insight and risk-based recommendations that improve release confidence.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Test Strategy, Planning & Analysis**
--------------------------------------

* Contribute to test strategies and create proportionate test plans based on scope, quality risks, dependencies and release objectives.

* Review requirements, user stories, designs and acceptance criteria to identify gaps, ambiguity, testability concerns and required coverage.

* Define test scenarios, test cases, test data, environment needs, entry and exit criteria and traceability to requirements.

* Apply risk-based testing to focus effort on business-critical journeys, integrations and operational risks.

* Provide clear test estimates, progress reporting, quality metrics and evidence for delivery governance and release decisions.

**Manual & Exploratory Testing**
--------------------------------

* Implement manual functional, integration, system, regression, smoke, exploratory and end-to-end testing across digital products and services.

* Validate user journeys, content workflows, business rules, integrations, permissions, data handling and error scenarios.

* Test responsive behaviour, usability, cross-browser compatibility and accessibility against agreed standards.

* Work with business users and Business Analysts to support UAT, capture evidence and confirm acceptance outcomes.

* Perform production verification and support early-life testing following releases.

**Test Automation & Continuous Testing**
----------------------------------------

* Design, build and maintain reliable automated tests for UI, API, integration, regression and end-to-end scenarios.

* Develop reusable test libraries, page objects, fixtures, utilities and test data aligned to sound software engineering principles.

* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and establish quality checks that provide rapid, repeatable feedback.

* Select appropriate candidates for automation, balancing business value, stability, maintenance effort and execution speed.

* Monitor automation reliability, investigate failures and continuously improve coverage, execution time and maintainability.

**Defect Management & Quality Insight**
---------------------------------------

* Log clear, reproducible defects with evidence, business impact, severity and appropriate diagnostic information.

* Work with engineers and suppliers to triage defects, investigate root causes, validate fixes and prevent recurrence.

* Maintain transparent defect status, highlight release risks and escalate unresolved quality concerns with options.

* Analyse defect patterns, escaped defects, automation results and quality trends to identify improvement opportunities.

* Contribute to retrospectives and root-cause reviews, turning lessons into stronger requirements, engineering and test practices.

**Collaboration & Quality Culture**
-----------------------------------

* Collaborate with product, analysis, design, development, operations, security, privacy and supplier teams throughout delivery.

* Champion shift-left testing by engaging early in discovery, refinement and technical design discussions.

* Promote shared ownership of quality and support engineers in improving unit, component and integration testing.

* Maintain test documentation, evidence, dashboards and reusable knowledge assets.

* Share testing practices and support continuous improvement across bp and supplier delivery teams.

  
  

**Skills & Experience**
=======================

* Experience testing digital products, web platforms, CMS solutions, APIs, integrations or cloud-based services using both manual and automated approaches.

* Solid understanding of test design techniques, exploratory testing, regression testing, defect management and requirements traceability.

* Hands-on experience developing and maintaining UI and API automation using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman or equivalent.

* Coding or scripting experience in TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Python or a comparable language, with Git-based version control.

* Experience integrating automated testing into Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD platforms.

* Understanding of accessibility, responsive, cross-browser, performance, security and operational-readiness testing.

* Experience working in Agile teams and collaborating with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Engineers and suppliers.

* Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to provide evidence-based quality recommendations.

  
  

**Success Measures**
====================

* Clear test coverage and traceability across requirements, business journeys, risks and acceptance criteria.

* Early identification of defects, gaps and release risks, reducing rework and production issues.

* Reliable and maintainable automated regression coverage integrated into delivery pipelines.

* Timely, evidence-based quality reporting that supports informed release decisions.

* Improved platform quality across functionality, accessibility, usability, performance, security and operability.

* Effective defect resolution and measurable reduction in repeated or escaped defects.

Strong collaboration and shared quality ownership across business, product, engineering and supplier

  
  

**About bp**
------------

  
  

Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner!

title: Lead Embedded Software Engineer
description:
**Lead Embedded Software Engineer**

**Are you a highly motivated, creative individual and passionate about developing high quality product with impacts?**

**Would you like to be a part of successful team?**

**Join our team!**

Baker Hughes is a global energy technology company serving energy and industrial customers in more than 120 countries. Built on over a century of innovation, the company provides advanced products, services, and digital solutions that support efficient, safe, and lower‑carbon energy operations. Its portfolio spans oilfield services and equipment, turbomachinery, industrial technologies, and emerging energy transition solutions such as hydrogen, carbon capture, and emissions management. Baker Hughes continues to help customers meet the world’s evolving energy needs through technology leadership, operational excellence, and a strong commitment to sustainability.  
  
**Partner with the best**

As a Lead Embedded Software Engineer in our SmartServices - Completions, Interventions and Measurements team, you will design, develop, and support the embedded software and configurations that power Baker Hughes’ acoustic telemetry technologies. You’ll work with C/C++, embedded peripherals and systems, real-time operating systems (RTOS), and industrial communication protocols to deliver reliable, high‑performance systems for challenging downhole environments. Depending on experience, you may also guide technical decisions, mentor engineers, and lead software activities across global projects.

As a **Lead Embedded Software Engineer**, you will also be responsible for:

  

* Understanding system level requirements and expectations.
* Analyzing existing complex multi-component FW/SW systems to assess the implementation and integration of new features, including code test and system regression testing methodologies.
* Delivering embedded software for microcontrollers including interacting with communication protocols / buses; low level driver development; measurement and digital signal processing; and RTOS.
* Developing algorithm and answer products for sensor solutions.
* Developing high-quality and resilient firmware solutions as part of a cross functional team including scientists, and mechanical, electric and system engineers.
* Participating in code reviews and system performance reviews at various stages of development.
* Assessing opportunities for firmware improvements.
* Supporting qualification testing, field trials, and failure investigation of current and future products. Handling special projects, as assigned.

**Fuel your passion!**

To be successful in this role you will:

* Have bachelor’s degree in electronic, Electrical, Computer Engineering or Computer Science with 10+ years design experience; Master’s Degree in a related field with 5+ years design experience; or Ph.D. in a related field with 2+ years’ design experience.
* Have experience with programming microcontrollers using embedded C or embedded C++.
* Have experience in using electronics measurement and laboratory equipment.
* Have experience in firmware design, testing, and debugging.
* Have demonstrated experience using AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, CodeWhisperer) to improve development efficiency, firmware quality, documentation, and test automation in embedded software projects.
* Proficient in oral and written English language. Ability to prepare written technical reports and present results.
* Ability to work with remote-teams in different time-zones, time-shifting to evenings when necessary.

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Experience working with large SW and FW systems and networks.
* Developed code for fault resistant systems / understanding of design-for-reliability requirements.
* Worked with DSP and microprocessor systems and architecture.

title: Software Engineer – Internal Platforms & Tools
company: Therm-x India Engineering and Manufacturing Pvt. Ltd.
description:
**Role Summary**

Therm-X is expanding its suite of internal software platforms, tools, and scripts that support engineering, manufacturing, and test operations across the organization — spanning web-based management systems, database and system integrations, desktop field clients, and automation for test and measurement equipment. We are hiring a Software Engineer to help develop, extend, and maintain these internal systems as part of a small, high-ownership team based in our India remote support facility.

This is a hands-on, full-stack software engineering role. **A core part of how we work is AI-assisted, agentic programming** — engineers work fluently alongside AI coding agents to design, draft, refactor, and test code, and are expected to critically review and take full ownership of the results. A strong foundation in programming and computer science is essential, because the engineer must judge correctness, structure, and maintainability rather than simply accept generated output.

The role starts as a single contributor and is expected to grow to a team of two to three as the platform expands.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Develop, extend, and maintain** web application features and internal tools across the full stack (backend, database, and front end), from design through deployment.
* **Work alongside** AI coding agents as a primary development tool — directing them effectively, then reviewing, debugging, testing, and owning the code they produce.
* **Integrate** internal platforms with external systems and services (ERP, Microsoft 365 / Graph, document stores, and internal APIs) to enable reliable data flow.
* **Develop** and maintain automation for test and measurement systems — e.g., scripting data capture and control for test chambers and instrumentation — and support the desktop field-client application used to interface with equipment on site.
* **Troubleshoot** bugs, data issues, and integration problems across the platform, reasoning through complex workflows end to end.
* **Design and maintain** schema changes, queries, and stored procedures against SQL Server, following the platform's data and audit conventions.
* **Produce** clear technical documentation and follow code review and deployment discipline appropriate to a small, remote team.
* **Collaborate** with HQ engineering to prioritize work, clarify requirements, and drive continuous improvement of the platform.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

**Education & Experience**

* **Bachelor's degree** in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related field (a strong programming and CS foundation is required).
* **2–5+ years of experience** building and maintaining web applications or line-of-business software systems.

**Core Competency – AI-Assisted / Agentic Programming**

* **Demonstrated proficiency** using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code or similar) as a day-to-day development tool.
* **Ability** to critically review AI-generated code — assessing correctness, security, structure, and maintainability — and to debug and take ownership of it.
* **Solid grasp** of software fundamentals (data structures, control flow, APIs, testing) sufficient to direct an agent well and to work effectively when the agent is wrong.

**Technical Skills**

* **C# and** ASP.NET Core / .NET — primary application framework.
* **SQL Server** (T-SQL), including complex queries, full CRUD operations, and schema design.
* **Vanilla JavaScript**, HTML, and CSS for front-end work (the platform uses a lightweight, no-build-toolchain approach — no heavy SPA framework required).
* **Building** and consuming REST APIs and vendor/system interfaces (SDKs, HTTP integrations).
* **Python** for specialized services, automation scripts, and interfacing with test and measurement equipment (e.g., test chambers, instrumentation, and data acquisition).
* **Strong troubleshooting**, analytical, and system-level problem-solving skills.

**Professional Skills**

* Ability to work independently with high ownership as an early or sole contributor, scaling into a small team as it grows.
* Strong written and verbal communication for effective remote, cross-functional collaboration with HQ (including time-zone overlap and async work).
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications**

* **Experience** with IIS deployment and Windows server environments.
* **Familiarity** with Microsoft 365 integration (Graph API, SharePoint, Teams, Power Automate).
* **Domain familiarity** of engineering or manufacturing workflows — helpful for understanding the platforms' users and the problems they solve (e.g., ECO/document control, ERP concepts, inspection or quality processes).
* **Experience** building desktop applications (e.g., Electron or similar) for field/on-site use.
* **Exposure** to test and measurement or industrial automation — instrument protocols, data acquisition, or interfacing with lab/factory equipment.
* **Exposure to** integrating with ERP systems (e.g., Epicor) or other enterprise systems of record.
* **Experience** with document/drawing management and configuration/change management concepts.

**What You'll Work On**

* Feature development and maintenance across internal platform modules (project/task management, document control, ERP integration, inspection, asset/maintenance, and more).
* Database and API work connecting internal platforms to internal and external systems.
* Automation and tooling for test and measurement systems, plus the desktop field client used with equipment on site.
* AI-assisted development workflows that let a small team deliver at a larger team's pace.
* Internal tools and dashboards supporting engineering across the organization.
