title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
**Overview:**

As the principal engineer, you will define and drive Nerdy’s technical vision and architecture across multiple teams, architect complex systems at scale, and elevate engineering quality—while advancing AI-powered capabilities that improve how learners and tutors connect and succeed.

**About Nerdy:**

At Nerdy (NYSE: NRDY) - the company behind Varsity Tutors - we’re redrawing the blueprint of learning. Our Live + AI™ platform fuses real-time human expertise with proprietary generative-AI systems, setting a new bar for measurable academic impact at global scale.

We recruit the kind of technologists and operators you’d bet on as solo founders - people who turn ambiguous problems into shipping code, iterate faster than markets move, and compound their advantage with every data point. In an era where great employees can deliver 10-times the leverage of the merely good, we back those who play to win.

Fortune favors the bold. Join us.

**How we compete:**

* **AI-Native at every level**  
  From the CEO to day-one hires, everyone builds and ships with generative AI. If you’re not wielding AI, you’re not done.
* **Entrepreneurial velocity**  
  Move at founder speed, prototype in hours, and measure in real user outcomes. Slow teams die.
* **Free-market rigor**  
  Ideas rise or fall on merit and results - no committees, no politics, no cap on upside.
* **Full-stack ownership**  
  You design, build, and run what you ship; accountability is a feature, not a bug.
* **Reward for contribution**  
  Pay rises with impact, not years. Outstanding results earn outsized rewards. We evaluate both ***what*** you achieve and ***how*** you achieve it: living our leadership principles and using AI effectively are formally measured and rewarded.
* **Relentless exploration**  
  Push the frontier of generative AI in live learning and - because only the paranoid survive - questioning every legacy assumption along the way.
* **Is Apolitical**  
  You stay focused on mission-aligned outcomes, not distractions or unrelated causes.

If you’re a technically minded builder who thrives on open competition, personal responsibility, and the chance to redefine how the world learns - while continually stretching the limits of what generative AI can do - come do the most ambitious and rewarding work of your career here. Learn more at nerdy.com.  
  
**Nerdy’s shareholder letters below explain our latest products and strategy:**

* Q2-2026 Shareholder Letter
* Q1-2026 Shareholder Letter
* Q4-2025 Shareholder Letter

**Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of software engineering with deep hands-on experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems; 3+ years leading technical direction across multiple teams.
* Expertise in service-oriented and event-driven architectures; microservices for UX and APIs in cloud environments (AWS preferred).
* Strong data systems background: streaming (e.g., Kinesis/Kafka), big-data processing (e.g., Spark/Hive), and storage (DynamoDB/Redis/RDBMS).
* Proficiency in CI/CD and infrastructure as code (e.g., CodeDeploy/CodeBuild, Terraform/CloudFormation); solid Linux and command-line skills.
* AI/ML experience shipping to production: designing RAG pipelines, model serving, recommendations/ranking, evaluation (offline/online), monitoring, and drift/quality management.
* Responsible AI practices: privacy, security, safety, bias mitigation, and auditability; experience integrating AI guardrails into apps and platforms.
* AI-native developer productivity: skilled with tools that accelerate teams (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Make.com, n8n, Supabase, Netlify, Vercel, Grok, Bolt) and with prompt/tool orchestration and evaluation.
* Strong coding fundamentals (OO design, algorithms, data structures) in one or more languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go, TypeScript).
* Clear communicator with executive presence; able to translate complex technical trade-offs for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Familiarity with AWS services (e.g., EC2, RDS, Kinesis, DynamoDB) and deploying large-scale web applications.
* Aptitude to quickly learn new languages/technologies; growth mindset and high ownership.
* Understand and appreciate that Nerdy is an apolitical company, united in the focus on helping people learn.

**Responsibilities:**

* Set the org-wide architectural strategy and guardrails; create reference designs and patterns that align teams on a coherent technical direction.
* Architect and deliver cross-cutting, highly scalable systems (e.g., live learning platform, eventing/data pipelines, identity/auth, APIs).
* Lead AI architecture end-to-end: design LLM/RAG systems, recommendations/ranking, vector search, feature stores, and online/offline evaluation loops.
* Productionize ML/LLM solutions with robust MLOps/LLMOps (model/prompt versioning, CI/CD for models, canaries, shadow deploys, monitoring, drift detection).
* Ensure responsible AI: establish guardrails for privacy, safety, bias, and prompt-injection defense in partnership with Security/Legal/Compliance.
* Drive performance, scalability, and resiliency (caching, backpressure, idempotency, multi-region, disaster recovery); own SLOs and observability.
* Raise the quality bar through hands-on coding on critical paths, design reviews, documentation, automated testing, and continuous delivery.
* Champion secure-by-default and privacy-by-design; lead threat modeling and collaborate on compliance needs (e.g., GDPR/CCPA/SOX/NIST).
* Partner with product, data science/ML, design, and engineering leadership to sequence investments and align on outcomes and trade-offs.
* Mentor and uplevel engineers and managers; lead architecture forums/guilds; influence through clarity, empathy, and data.
* Operate iteratively with a focus on quality; participate in on-call, lead incident response/postmortems, and drive reliability and cost stewardship (FinOps).

**Unleash Your Potential at Nerdy:**

At Nerdy, you'll earn your success through meritocracy and exceptional outcomes. Our benefits reward performance and initiative:

* **Competitive USD-Benchmarked Compensation:** Earn a market-leading rate set in U.S. dollars, paid to you in local currency.
* **100% Remote (Home Country Only):** Work from anywhere in your home country—no relocation required, no borders crossed.
* **Flexible Time Off:** Our flexible PTO lets you recharge on your own terms and when you need it the most.
* **Local Holiday Pay:** We honor your nation’s official holidays with paid time off—celebrate what matters to you.
* **Continuous Learning:** Get a free, all-inclusive learning membership for you and your household—including 1-on-1 tutoring hours, unlimited on-demand classes, and access to our full suite of learning products and services.
* **Supercharge with AI:** Gain exclusive access to cutting-edge AI tools that boost your productivity, making you feel almost super-human (cape not included).
* **Feedback-Rich, Collaborative Culture:** Tap into regular training, peer reviews, and a team that treats every team member as a vital collaborator and owner in our success.
* **Make a Global Impact:** Your expertise fuels an innovative platform used by learners around the world—be part of something transformative.

**The Bottom Line:**

If you're driven by impact, energized by ownership, and excited to help shape what’s next, you’ll thrive here. We move fast, think big, and reward those who deliver. This isn’t a traditional corporate environment - it’s a place to do the most meaningful work of your career.

title: Software Engineer I
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
About the RoleAs a Software Engineer I on the Martech Intelligence Pod, you'll be starting your engineering career working on real customer-facing applications across both frontend and backend, learning the foundations of professional software development in a supportive environment. You'll also have the opportunity to explore and learn about AI tools and AI-centric solutions that are becoming central to how we build products.
  
  
Your primary focus will be maintaining and improving the customer-facing websites we host while gradually learning about infrastructure and integration challenges the Intelligence Pod tackles. Importantly, you'll also have dedicated time to explore AI tools, experiment with LLM APIs, understand how agents work, and think about where AI can solve problems better than traditional approaches.
  
  
**This is a structured onboarding role:** you'll work closely with senior engineers who will mentor you through the full development lifecycle — from understanding requirements, to writing frontend components and backend services, to testing, debugging, and deploying to production. You'll start with well-scoped, low-risk tasks on both frontend and backend, and gradually take on more responsibility as you gain confidence and expertise. You'll also spend time experimenting with AI tools, building small proof-of-concepts, and learning how modern AI capabilities can be integrated into applications.
  
  
The role demands intellectual curiosity, a willingness to ask questions, and genuine interest in learning how real systems work — both traditional software and AI-powered systems. Success is measured by your growth as a full-stack engineer, the quality of code you write, your reliability, your ability to communicate what you're learning, and your engagement with exploring AI as a tool and mindset. This is a fully-supported entry point into professional full-stack software engineering at a global scale, with exposure to cutting-edge AI capabilities.
  
  
Who You AreWe're optimizing for learning potential, solid fundamentals, and genuine engagement with engineering. You don't need years of experience — you need to be curious, humble about what you don't know, and eager to grow.
  
You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent bootcamp/self-taught experience with a portfolio demonstrating competency
  
You are proficient in English, both written and verbal, sufficient for success in a remote and largely asynchronous work environment
  
You have 0-2 years of professional software engineering experience, or are a recent graduate with solid foundational knowledge
  
You have hands-on experience writing code in C# or Java (through academic projects, bootcamp, or personal projects) and understand the basics of how programs work
  
You have some experience with React and TypeScript or are eager to learn them quickly — through academic projects, bootcamp, tutorials, or personal projects; you understand the basics of components and JSX
  
You know the basics of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — you understand how the browser works and can build simple web pages and interactive elements
  
You understand the fundamentals of object-oriented programming: classes, objects, inheritance, and interfaces
  
**You can debug code in multiple environments:** backend (logs, IDE debugger) and frontend (browser developer tools, console logs)
  
You've written code that other people have read and reviewed — you're comfortable receiving feedback and iterating
  
You know the basics of relational databases and can write simple SQL queries (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE); you're learning to think about data
  
You've worked with Git and understand the basics of version control, branching, and merging
  
**You can debug code systematically:** read error messages, add logging, trace through code, form hypotheses about what's wrong
  
You're genuinely curious about how things work and you ask good questions when you don't understand something
  
You're interested in and curious about AI tools (LLMs, generative AI, agents) — you've probably experimented with ChatGPT, Claude, or similar tools and think about how they could be useful
  
You're open to exploring AI-centric solutions to problems and willing to experiment with new approaches that leverage AI capabilities
  
**You can explain what you've learned in writing:** you're comfortable documenting decisions, asking for help in PRs, and sharing what you discovered
  
**You're reliable and follow through:** you finish what you start, communicate when you're blocked, and ask for help before getting stuck for too long
  
You're humble about what you don't know and genuinely want to learn from more experienced engineers
  
You make an effort to include others and appreciate feedback as a gift, not a criticism
  
  
**What You'll DoLearning & Foundational Work:**  
Work on small, well-scoped tasks with clear acceptance criteria: bug fixes, simple feature additions, documentation improvements (both frontend and backend)
  
**Get hands-on with the tools and technologies we use:** C#/Java backend, React/TypeScript frontend, SQL, Git, our test frameworks, our deployment processes
  
**Learn how our customer-facing applications work:** what AEM is, how WordPress sites are structured, how they serve customers, how frontend and backend work together
  
**Understand the full development lifecycle:** from understanding a requirement, to writing code (frontend components and backend services), to testing, to deploying to production with safety
  
  
**Frontend Development:**  
**Fix simple bugs in our React/TypeScript applications:** layout issues, component state problems, missing features
  
**Implement small features:** simple forms, content displays, UI improvements requested by stakeholders
  
**Learn React fundamentals:** components, hooks, props, state management
  
**Debug frontend issues using browser developer tools:** understand CSS problems, trace JavaScript execution
  
**Help improve frontend test coverage:** write simple unit tests for components
  
**Learn how to consume backend APIs from the frontend:** understand requests, responses, error handling
  
  
**Backend Development:**  
**Help fix bugs in our C# or Java backend services:** simple issues with clear reproduction steps
  
**Implement small backend features:** API endpoints, database queries, business logic
  
**Learn backend fundamentals:** how services are structured, how databases work, how to handle errors
  
**Debug backend issues:** read logs, understand stack traces, trace through code
  
**Help improve test coverage:** write simple unit and integration tests
  
**Learn how different systems connect:** understand what the Intelligence Pod builds
  
  
**Customer-Facing Site Support:**  
Help maintain and support http://jll.com (AEM) and WordPress installations — responding to issues, fixing bugs, implementing small improvements
  
**Participate in code review:** both receiving feedback on your code and reviewing code from peers (with guidance)
  
**Help with code maintenance:** refactoring simple code, improving documentation, reducing technical debt
  
  
**Learning Infrastructure & Integration Concepts:**  
**Observe and help with integration work:** understand how we connect to external systems, why these connections are fragile, how errors are handled
  
**Learn what the broader Intelligence Pod does:** building MCPs, working with agents, connecting marketing systems together
  
**Ask questions and document what you learn:** you're building your mental model of how these systems work
  
  
**AI Exploration & Learning:**  
**Dedicate time to learning and experimenting with AI tools:** LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, etc.), prompt engineering, understanding how agents work
  
**Build small personal projects and proof-of-concepts using AI:** tools that solve real problems, experiments that help you understand AI capabilities and limitations
  
**Explore how AI can be integrated into our applications:** think about where AI could improve user experience, automate tasks, or unlock new capabilities
  
**Learn about agent systems, multi-step reasoning, and tool use:** understand what the Intelligence Pod is building and why
  
**Document your experiments and learnings:** write up what you tried, what worked, what didn't, and what you discovered
  
Participate in code reviews and discussions about AI-centric solutions: understand how senior engineers think about AI architecture and tradeoffs
  
**Stay current on AI developments:** follow announcements, experiment with new models/tools, and bring ideas back to the team
  
  
**Development Practices:**  
**Write tests for code you write:** unit tests on both frontend and backend, simple integration tests
  
Deploy code to production (with a more experienced engineer watching/guiding the first few times)
  
**Debug production issues under mentorship:** learn to read logs, understand error messages, trace through systems
  
Participate in on-call rotation for customer-facing applications: responding to issues, escalating when needed
  
  
**Growing Your Skills:**  
**Learn from code review:** understand why experienced engineers structure code certain ways, ask questions about their decisions
  
**Pair program with senior engineers:** watch how they debug, design, and think through problems on both frontend and backend
  
**Work on increasingly complex tasks as you gain confidence:** from bug fixes, to small features, to contributing to larger pieces of infrastructure work
  
**Contribute to improving our team:** documentation, test coverage, code clarity, processes that make everyone more effective
  
  
**Communication & Collaboration:**  
Write clear commit messages and PR descriptions
  
Ask questions in team channels when you're stuck — don't wait until you're frustrated
  
Communicate regularly with your mentors about what you're learning, where you're struggling, and what you want to focus on next
  
**Help teammates when you can:** testing code, reviewing docs, asking clarifying questions
  
  
Nice to HaveAcademic or bootcamp projects demonstrating full-stack fundamentals (both frontend and backend)
  
Experience with Git, GitHub, or similar version control in a team setting
  
Familiarity with frontend testing frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library) or backend testing frameworks
  
Experience with databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) beyond just basic SQL
  
Exposure to state management in React (Context API, Redux, Zustand, etc.)
  
Exposure to CSS frameworks or CSS-in-JS libraries (Tailwind, styled-components, etc.)
  
Exposure to backend frameworks or libraries (http://ASP.NET , Spring, etc.)
  
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) or containerization (Docker)
  
Interest in marketing technology, content management systems, or enterprise software
  
Experimentation with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, etc.) or interest in learning about LLMs
  
Personal projects or experiments using AI APIs or tools
  
Understanding of or curiosity about agent systems, prompt engineering, or generative AI
  
Open source contributions or a GitHub profile showing projects you've worked on
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

The role includes work related to embedded security, standards-based automotive connectivity technologies, and interoperability-focused software development.

You will work closely with globally distributed engineering teams and technical leadership to implement high-quality software that meets functional, reliability, safety, and cybersecurity expectations for automotive deployments.

This role is well suited for engineers who enjoy broad technical ownership, hands-on product development, solving system-level problems, and collaborating across disciplines in a fast-moving environment while maintaining high standards for software quality and engineering rigor.

Strong communication skills, ownership, and collaborative execution are essential for success in this role, including regular coordination with remote technical leadership across time zones.

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
* 8-10+ years of professional experience in embedded software and firmware development.

**Core Technical Skills:**

* Strong programming skills in C and C++.
* Working knowledge of Python for scripting, tooling, automation, or test development.

* Comfortable collaborating with globally distributed engineering teams across shared time-zone overlap windows.

Candidates are encouraged to highlight experience in any of the following areas:

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
**Lead Mobile Software Engineer (P4)**

**Who We Are**

Solera is a global leader in data and software services, transforming every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our teams work on mission‑critical platforms that demand reliability, scalability, and thoughtful evolution of complex systems.

**JOB SUMMARY**

* We’re looking for a hands-on Lead Mobile Software Engineer (P4) who will help design, build, modernize, and deliver enterprise-grade mobile applications across iOS and Android. This role is focused on building reliable, scalable, secure, and high-performing mobile experiences while applying AI-driven development practices to improve engineering velocity, product quality, and team effectiveness.

* Leads meaningful mobile features and workstreams across discovery, design, implementation, launch, and continuous improvement
* Designs and builds cross-platform mobile solutions spanning iOS, Android, and shared mobile components
* Applies AI-driven development practices, AI-assisted engineering tools, and modern mobile workflows to improve delivery speed and product quality

* You will operate with strong ownership, lead mobile workstreams with limited direction, help shape implementation approaches, support cross-team alignment, and be known as someone who ships high-quality mobile software, unblocks teammates, and drives execution.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Build, Ship, and Own Mobile Applications**

* Write production-quality mobile code regularly across iOS, Android, shared components, and mobile integration layers
* Own and deliver mobile features, platform improvements, and system enhancements end-to-end
* Contribute to modernization of legacy mobile applications by helping move toward modular, maintainable, testable, and scalable mobile architectures

* Integrate mobile applications with AI-enabled backend services, APIs, orchestration layers, and data sources
* Evaluate tradeoffs for on-device, edge, or cloud-based intelligence based on latency, privacy, cost, reliability, and user experience
* Follow and help improve guardrails for AI-assisted mobile engineering, including generated-code review standards, testing expectations, security review, privacy controls, and quality gates
* Support validation strategies for AI-powered mobile features, including grounding, structured outputs, user confirmation, fallback states, and telemetry-driven evaluation
* Help implement monitoring and feedback loops for AI-enabled mobile behavior in production
* Ensure AI-enabled mobile capabilities meet security, privacy, compliance, accessibility, and user trust requirements

**Mobile Technical Leadership & Architecture**

* Contribute to mobile architecture standards through hands-on implementation
* Guide implementation decisions across native iOS, native Android, cross-platform frameworks, shared components, backend integration, data synchronization, security, and observability
* Make thoughtful tradeoffs between native platform quality, cross-platform reuse, delivery speed, performance, correctness, and maintainability
* Act as a technical escalation point for assigned mobile areas, including performance, memory, battery usage, offline behavior, crash stability, OS compatibility, release quality, and integration reliability
* Influence technical direction within the team and across related mobile workstreams
* Provide technical leadership for assigned projects by coordinating architecture input, engineering execution, dependency management, risk mitigation, mobile release planning, and cross-team alignment
* Communicate clearly with product owners, UX/design, engineering leaders, backend teams, security, DevOps/SRE, QA, support, and business stakeholders to keep delivery aligned with business outcomes

**AI-Assisted Mobile Engineering & Developer Productivity**

* Use AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, and mobile-specific automation to accelerate high-quality delivery
* Follow and promote best practices for safe, high-quality AI-assisted mobile coding
* Use AI tools for mobile solution design, architecture analysis, refactoring, test generation, debugging, system comprehension, documentation, and release readiness
* Improve developer productivity through reusable mobile components, shared architecture patterns, CI/CD automation, test automation, build optimization, and platform tooling
* Help the team adopt modern mobile workflows that improve velocity while maintaining engineering rigor, security, accessibility, and release quality

**Mentorship & Team Elevation**

* Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, architecture discussions, and implementation support
* Help mid-level and senior engineers strengthen mobile engineering practices and ownership
* Coach teammates on modern mobile architecture, cross-platform development, AI-aware engineering practices, quality engineering, observability, and secure development
* Promote a culture of continuous learning, ownership, customer empathy, and technical excellence
* Lead by example with clear communication, accountability, collaboration, and hands-on technical contribution

**Mobile Execution, Quality & Operations**

* Build and maintain enterprise mobile applications using modern native and/or cross-platform frameworks
* Implement integrations with RESTful APIs, GraphQL services, event-driven workflows, identity providers, analytics platforms, and mobile backend services
* Optimize mobile applications for performance, memory usage, battery life, network efficiency, offline behavior, accessibility, localization, and reliability
* Partner with DevOps/SRE and QA to support strong mobile CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, build signing, release automation, observability, crash reporting, and safe deployments
* Support release quality across TestFlight, Google Play testing tracks, App Store, and Google Play production releases
* Participate fully in the SDLC: design, coding, testing, deployment, production support, incident response, and continuous improvement

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

**Experience**

* 7+ years of professional software development experience, including significant hands-on mobile engineering experience
* Proven experience delivering complex mobile applications, mobile features, or mobile platform capabilities
* Experience contributing to modernization of legacy mobile applications, mobile architectures, or mobile delivery practices
* Hands-on experience building and shipping iOS and Android applications, with cross-platform mobile development experience
* Experience applying AI-assisted development tools and AI-driven engineering practices to improve quality, speed, testing, documentation, and maintainability
* History of hands-on technical leadership within a team, project, or mobile workstream
* Experience mentoring engineers and supporting code quality through reviews and technical guidance
* Proven ability to lead assigned project workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders, manage technical risks, and drive execution through delivery

**Technical Skills**

* Strong mobile engineering experience across iOS and Android
* Strong proficiency with Swift and iOS platform development, including Apple platform conventions, app lifecycle, concurrency, networking, persistence, testing, and App Store release practices
* Strong proficiency with Kotlin and Android platform development, including Android architecture, Jetpack, coroutines, networking, persistence, testing, and Google Play release practices
* Hands-on experience with cross-platform mobile technologies such as React Native, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform, .NET MAUI, or equivalent frameworks
* Solid understanding of mobile architecture patterns such as MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture, modular architecture, dependency injection, and design-system integration
* Experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, identity providers, telemetry platforms, crash reporting, analytics, feature flags, and remote configuration
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools and AI-enabled engineering workflows
* Working knowledge of LLM-powered product experiences, AI service integration, prompt-driven workflows, structured outputs, validation, and responsible AI guardrails
* Strong understanding of mobile security, secure storage, authentication, authorization, privacy, encryption, certificate pinning, OWASP Mobile risks, and compliance-aware engineering
* Strong experience with mobile testing strategies, including unit testing, UI automation, integration testing, contract testing, snapshot testing, and regression automation
* Experience with mobile CI/CD, build automation, signing, provisioning, release tracks, app store submission, observability, and production monitoring
* Comfort working with cloud environments and backend integration patterns across AWS and/or Azure
* Proficient with Git and modern development workflows
* Strong understanding of production-quality code, performance tuning, reliability engineering, accessibility, and user-centered mobile design

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience with .NET MAUI, or other cross-platform mobile frameworks at scale
* Experience building shared mobile platform libraries, SDKs, design systems, or reusable component frameworks
* Experience with offline-first mobile applications, synchronization, conflict resolution, and intermittent connectivity scenarios
* Experience with mobile observability, crash analytics, performance monitoring, synthetic monitoring, and SLO-driven reliability practices
* Experience integrating AI-powered features into mobile applications, including on-device AI, cloud AI services, personalization, automation, or contextual assistants
* Experience with regulated, security-sensitive, or compliance-driven mobile applications
* Background with event streaming, messaging, or real-time data workflows
* Strong background in Agile/Scrum environments

**EDUCATION**

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* You are consistently delivering high-quality mobile features and improvements across iOS and Android
* Mobile applications are becoming more reliable, performant, secure, observable, accessible, and easier to release
* Legacy mobile systems are being improved incrementally without disrupting customers or business operations
* AI-assisted engineering practices improve team velocity, code quality, test coverage, and documentation quality
* AI-enabled mobile capabilities are implemented responsibly, monitored effectively, and trusted in production
* The team moves faster because of the mobile patterns, tools, automation, and examples you help establish
* Engineers seek you out for guidance on mobile implementation, cross-platform decisions, AI-assisted development, release quality, and production issues
* Assigned projects are well-scoped, well-communicated, and delivered through effective collaboration with product, design, engineering, operations, security, QA, and business stakeholders
* Code quality, mobile reliability, release confidence, and development velocity improve measurably
* You are recognized as a lead engineer who ships, collaborates effectively, and raises the quality of the team around you

description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**Staff Software Development Engineer - OpenBMC / Platform Management**

**THE ROLE:**

AMD is seeking a highly motivated Software Development Engineer to join our Embedded System Software team, building the OpenBMC and platform management software that runs on AMD Adaptive SoC platforms. You will contribute to the OpenBMC distribution for AMD platforms, delivering management, telemetry, and serviceability for servers, AI accelerators, and next-generation data center and embedded systems.

Working alongside AMD silicon architects, hardware designers, firmware teams, and the OpenBMC open-source community, you will take new platforms from first power-on through to a supportable, upstreamable solution, and build the reference designs that AMD product teams and external customers adopt for their own platforms.

**THE PERSON:**

The ideal candidate is passionate about platform management software and enjoys solving complex system-level challenges that span hardware and software boundaries. You possess strong software engineering fundamentals, deep expertise in OpenBMC and embedded Linux, and a proven ability to drive features from concept through platform bring-up and into production.

You are comfortable working across the full stack, from an I2C device to a Redfish endpoint, and have the communication skills to collaborate effectively with architects and engineering teams across AMD.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **OpenBMC Software Stack:** Contribute to the OpenBMC distribution for AMD platforms, including the phosphor services, D-Bus interfaces, and application layer that deliver manageability on AMD platforms.
* **Hardware Description and Telemetry:** Develop Entity Manager configurations, sensor and FRU definitions, and the thermal, power, and fan control behaviour for each platform.
* **Management Interfaces:** Deliver the out-of-band management surface, including Redfish and bmcweb, IPMI, remote console and KVM, and MCTP and PLDM transports.
* **Firmware Update and Security:** Build the update and recovery path, including image signing, A/B and golden-image recovery, root-of-trust integration, secure boot, and attestation.
* **Platform and Board Bring-Up:** Participate in new platform and board bring-up from first power-on, driving issues to root cause with hardware, firmware, and silicon architecture teams.
* **Yocto Integration:** Maintain the Yocto layers and recipes that build and configure the BMC software stack across platforms and releases.
* **Upstream and Technical Leadership:** Contribute to the OpenBMC project, keep AMD trees in step with upstream, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to architecture reviews.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience with **OpenBMC** or a comparable BMC software stack, including components such as Entity Manager, D-Bus services, bmcweb and Redfish, and IPMI.
* Working knowledge of **BMC products and the platform management domain** — server, storage, or AI accelerator board bring-up, out-of-band management, remote console and KVM, and interfaces such as I2C, eSPI, PECI, APML, MCTP, and PLDM.
* Strong **embedded Linux** background, including the Linux kernel from a platform integration standpoint: device trees, kernel configuration, driver enablement, and sysfs and hwmon.
* Working experience with the **Yocto Project and OpenEmbedded** — layers, recipes, and bbappends.
* Strong programming skills in **C and C++**, and proficiency in Python or shell scripting.
* Experience debugging complex system-level issues spanning operating systems, drivers, firmware, and hardware, and familiarity with **Git and CI/CD** workflows.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Platform security and root of trust: secure and measured boot, firmware signing, and attestation.
* Experience developing **reference designs, demonstration platforms, or proof-of-concept solutions** adopted by product teams or external customers.
* **DC-SCM, DC-MHS, OCP**, or other modular hardware and open compute standards.
* Experience with **AMD Adaptive SoCs and FPGA technologies**, including AMD Vivado™ or Vitis™.
* **Zephyr or another embedded RTOS**, **RISC-V**, and inter-processor communication frameworks such as **OpenAMP**.
* Contributions to OpenBMC, Yocto Project, or Linux open-source projects.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, and demonstrated technical leadership.

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

Bachelor's degree + 8 years of experience or Master's degree + 6 years of experience in Computer

Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

title: Threat Research Engineer
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.*

An overview of this role

As an Threat Research Engineer at GitLab, you'll research emerging security threats and turn your findings into protection for GitLab customers. You'll investigate new attack surfaces, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems, and build systems that help detect threats and improve vulnerability advisories.  
This is a full-stack role: you'll take an idea from the first research question to a working proof of concept, deploy it, and analyze the results yourself. Artificial intelligence (AI) is central to how we work. You'll use AI tools daily and build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection.  
  
What you'll do

* Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.
* Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.
* Analyze software supply chain incidents and events.
* Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.
* Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work.
* Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories.
* Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences.

What you'll bring

* Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with an understanding of package ecosystems and software supply chain attacks.
* Both a developer mindset and an adversarial mindset: you can build systems and think about how to break them.
* Demonstrated experience using AI in real work, such as building with large language model (LLM) application programming interfaces (APIs) or agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or agent software development kits (SDKs).
* Strong programming skills in Go or Python, with good software engineering practices, including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and writing maintainable code.
* Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.
* The ability to map attack vectors, explain trade-offs, and use data to move experiments forward, balancing quality, speed, and customer outcomes.
* Clear writing for engineers and a general audience, and keeping up with security and AI industry trends.
* Helpful, but not required: Google Cloud Platform (GCP); Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) entries or published findings; research on AI agents, LLM applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers; blogs, talks, or open source security tools; Terraform or OpenTofu; databases or data pipelines at scale; reverse engineering.
* You don't need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing (SAST) engines. A high-level understanding is enough.

About the team  
We're the Threat Research group. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database, which powers GitLab's dependency scanning, and publish our findings on the Security Labs blog.  
Our work includes research on the Shai-Hulud npm worm and a critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in Serena, a popular MCP coding agent.

* Team Member Resource Groups

* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.*

**An overview of this role**
----------------------------

Help us build the next generation of authentication services at GitLab. As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Authentication team, you'll build authentication features across the Rails monolith and GATE. GATE is our new service for issuing and validating tokens and managing identities, designed to support every GitLab deployment model.

You'll expand authentication mechanisms, including support for identities used by artificial intelligence (AI) agents. You'll also help keep GitLab and its customers secure by building access management tooling and addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.

GATE will become the foundation for token issuance, validation, and identity services across GitLab.com multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS), Self-Managed, Dedicated, and air-gapped environments. Your work will affect core components that customers, users, and GitLab teams rely on.

Some of our projects include:

* Building GATE as the centralized service for token issuance and validation
* Consolidating tokens and migrating authentication paths out of the Rails monolith
* Building passkeys and passwordless authentication
* Developing composite identities that combine machine and human authorization for AI
* Improving service accounts and secure automation
* Enhancing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) capabilities for automated user provisioning and single sign-on (SSO)

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Shape the roadmap for GATE and GitLab's authentication services with the team.
* Design and implement token issuance, validation, and identity services in Go and Ruby across the Rails monolith and GATE, including new authentication mechanisms such as Workload Identity Federation.
* Migrate authentication and token management paths from the monolith into GATE while maintaining reliability across all deployment models.
* Build authentication mechanisms from the ground up, such as Workload Identity Federation.
* Strengthen security for users and organizations through access management tooling and by addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.
* Define and improve standards for style, maintainability, and engineering practices in a high-scale environment, and advocate for them through code review.
* Communicate publicly about GitLab initiatives, projects, and contributions from people not working for GitLab Inc. Reflect GitLab's values in these communications.
* Ship moderately sized features and improvements with moderate guidance and support from other team members, and collaborate on larger projects, including the build-out of GATE.
* Participate in the maintainer trainee program at your own comfortable pace while working toward becoming a project maintainer.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Professional experience with Go and/or Ruby in scaling or mission-critical SaaS products.
* Familiarity with authentication and authorization technologies or techniques, such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SSO, SCIM, LDAP, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), role-based access control (RBAC), or identity and access management (IAM).
* Knowledge of token systems, cryptographic signing, and key management.
* Experience building or contributing to a service from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, and execution.
* Proficiency in written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex problems and solutions clearly in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment.
* Experience diagnosing, preventing, and resolving performance and optimization problems.
* Experience working in an iterative software development process, managing your work effectively, staying organized, and following through on priorities.

**About the team**
------------------

Our mission is to empower GitLab system administrators with the toolkit they need to create their desired balance of security and accessibility for their GitLab experience.

Authentication is the first impression a new customer has when they configure a new GitLab instance. We aim to make it as seamless as possible, from that first login to onboarding users and managing security rules for their instance in a secure, flexible, and scalable way.

* Proven experience with **SOX audits, IT controls, and identity & access management** .
* Hands-on security experience with a **cloud ERP** . Oracle Fusion is preferred; SAP, Workday, or NetSuite are also considered.
* Functional knowledge of **Oracle EBS R12 and/or Oracle Fusion Financials** .
* Working knowledge of SQL, APIs, and scripting (Python or PowerShell).
* Clear communication with finance, audit, and technical stakeholders. Able to hold a vendor accountable while keeping the relationship strong.

* Experience with SailPoint, Okta, Coupa, Oracle EPM Cloud, Oracle Integration Cloud, or access-governance tools.
* Experience with an on-premise to cloud ERP migration.
* Exposure to AI-driven automation (Copilot Studio, AI Builder, document processing).
Certifications: CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CISM, CCSP, PL-500, PL-600, or ITIL.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

title: Mainframe DB2 System Programmer SME
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

As a Mainframe DB2 System Programmer SME at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services.

  

**Responsibilites include** :

* Installation/maintenance of IBM DB2 z/OS software and related 3rd-party products utilizing SMP/E. This includes working with IBM and other vendors to address product defects, issues, and usage questions.
* Configuration of DB2 groups and subsystems in SYSPLEX data-sharing environment, supporting mainframe DB2 applications.
* Perform problem analysis and resolution for mainframe DB2 system related issues.
* Performance and capacity tuning of system parameters and resources, utilizing various monitoring and reporting tools. Currently a separate team (PCM) handles this at Kyndryl.
* Responsible for the DB2 subsystem availability, backup and recovery strategies and procedures. DR tests.
* Maintain the DB2 Catalog, Directory and other DB2 system objects.
* Documentation of policies and procedures.
* Provide secondary support for the DBA staff on DB2 subsystem issues.
Security services in regards to systems support role for DB2.  

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* 7+ years IBM System Z experience and concepts, with considerable knowledge in the following:
  + **Administration & tooling:** software installation via SMP/E, along with database management and performance optimization using IBM, BMC, and Broadcom toolsets.
  + **Distributed access & security:** remote client/application connectivity via DDF and DRDA, integrated with RACF, ACF2, or TopSecret access control.
  + **Storage, DR & architecture:** FLASH copy, DASD replication, DB2 forward recovery, z/OS storage management, Coupling Facility, networking (TCP/IP, SNA), WLM, and USS.
* 5+ years IBM DB2 experience, with advanced knowledge in the following:
  + **Memory & internal structures:** buffer pools, page and tablespace layouts, and DB2 internal components (EDM pool, RIDs).
  + **Data sharing, logging & availability:** data sharing sysplex management, ZPARMS configuration, and backup, recovery, and logging strategies.
  + **Concurrency & performance diagnostics:** lock/latch contention management, IFCID tracing, and performance monitoring.
* Experience in problem determination and analysis
Analytical / critical / “outside-the-box” thinking in problem solving, especially in possible critical, high-pressure situations.  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.
* BMC Mainview For DB2, IBM Omegamon for DB2
* IBM Query Monitor for DB2
* Java, web services, SOA concepts
REXX programming  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Sr Statistical Programmer(ADaM & TLF)
description:
Sr Statistical Programmer(ADaM & TLF)

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  
  
Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.
  
  
Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.
  
  
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  
  
Why Syneos Health
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Uses SAS or other software to develop custom programming code to generate summary tables, data listings, graphs and derived datasets as specified in the statistical analysis plan and programming specifications.
* Works to ensure that outputs meet quality standards and project requirements. Performs validation programming and works with other Programmers, Biostatisticians, and other project team members to resolve discrepancies or any findings. Keeps project team members informed of programming progress and issues requiring their attention. Follow applicable SOPs, WIs, and relevant regulatory guidelines (e.g. ICH).
* Maintains well organized, complete, and up-to-date project documentation, testing, and verification/quality control documents and programs ensuring inspection readiness.
* Manages scheduling and time constraints across multiple projects at a time, sets goals based on priorities from management, and adapts to timeline or priority changes by reorganizing daily workload. Develops specifications for datasets and outputs of any complexity according to statistical and sponsor requirements. Anticipates and addresses potential programming issues, reflects forethought, establishes the basis for efficient programming and accurately defines all variables to be accepted by peer review and sponsor/requestor with little rework.
* Prepares in advance for internal meetings, contributes ideas, and demonstrates respect for opinions of others.
* Conducts effective internal meetings (appropriate in format, frequency and attendance). Distributes relevant information in advance. Ensures minutes are promptly and accurately distributed. Follows action items through to completion, and maintains order and focus of meetings, working toward consensus. Displays willingness to work with others and assist with projects and initiatives as necessary to meet the needs of the business. Negotiates and establishes accurate time estimates for completion of study programming activities with internal team members and statistical programming management, and completes project programming activities within timeframe allotted.
* Acts as the lead statistical programmer. Directs the programming activities of other programming personnel and monitors progress on programming deliverables. Reviews project documentation such as Statistical Analysis Plan, mock shells, programming specifications, annotated CRFs, and SAS database design. Provides feedback to the appropriate project team members which reflects forethought and reduces inefficiencies in programming activities.
* Participates in sponsor meetings, kickoff meetings, and bid defense meetings as statistical programming representative, as required by sponsor. Contributes to the mentoring of programming personnel through developing training courses, presenting training materials, reviewing work, and providing feedback or guiding new associates in process. Transfers deliverables. Performs other work-related duties as assigned.
Minimal travel may be required.  

  

Qualifications:

  

**Title: Senior Statistical Programmer (Sr SP)**

**Exp: 5-8 years of Experience**

**Location - INDIA - Remote / IND-Hyd-Hybrid**

**Key Requirements:**  
✅ Base SAS/ Advance SAS.
  
✅ Strong hands-on expertise in **ADaM programming, specs writing and TLF development**  
✅ Strong experience in Safety output
  
✅ Able to work as independent programmer
  
✅ Good to have hands on experience of Efficacy and late phase studies.

  

* Undergraduate degree, preferably in a scientific or statistical discipline; in lieu of degree, an equivalent combination of education and demonstrated programming experience.
* Extensive programming experience in SAS or other required software, preferably in a clinical trial environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.

**Get to know Syneos Health**

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

http://www.syneoshealth.com

**Additional Information**

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. title: Windows Endpoint Security Developer
description:
Join Hire Hangar and work with fast-growing global companies while building a long-term career.

**Job Title: Windows Endpoint Security Developer (C/C++ & Driver Development)**  
**Location | Remote**  
**Time Zone | US Time Zones (EST–PST)**

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a Windows Endpoint Security Developer with strong C, C++, and Windows driver development skills to help build an AI-focused endpoint protection platform. This is a full-time, hands-on engineering role. Your first focus will be building a Windows service that collects system, network, and process data to detect and respond to threats. The ideal candidate knows Windows internals well and enjoys building fast, reliable security software.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement Windows endpoint services, including kernel-mode and user-mode modules
* Develop Windows drivers (WDM, KMDF, UMDF) to monitor file system, process, memory, and network activity
* Build features that drive efficient data collection focused on AI behavioral monitoring
* Implement secure hooks and filters using Windows Filtering Platform (WFP), minifilters, and ETW
* Collaborate with the team on threat research strategies and translate them into detection logic using endpoint telemetry
* Perform advanced debugging and troubleshooting across kernel and user mode using WinDbg, crash dump analysis, and Sysinternals tools
* Ensure compliance with Microsoft driver signing, PatchGuard, Secure Boot, and kernel security restrictions
* Optimize agent performance to minimize system impact while maintaining visibility and protection
* Participate in threat modeling, secure coding reviews, and internal security assessments

**Required Qualifications:**

* Experience working on Windows endpoint security products such as AV, EDR, DLP, firewall, or intrusion prevention (non-negotiable)
* Deep expertise in C, C++, and Windows driver development
* Strong understanding of Windows OS fundamentals and internals
* Experience with kernel-mode communication mechanisms (IOCTL, ALPC, shared memory)
* Proficiency with WinDbg, crash dump analysis, and Sysinternals tools
* Knowledge of Windows Filtering Platform (WFP), minifilters, and ETW
* Understanding of Microsoft driver signing, PatchGuard, and Secure Boot
* Experience with threat modeling and secure coding practices
* Strong written and spoken English with a clear, professional communication style
* Must have prior remote work experience, be fluent with remote collaboration tools and platforms (such as Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Asana, or similar), and have ideally worked with US or UK-based companies. Applications without this experience will not be considered.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with cross-platform endpoint security (macOS/Linux)
* Experience building telemetry or behavioral analytics pipelines for threat detection
* Exposure to AI/ML-driven security products or monitoring AI agent activity

**Tools & Technology:**

* C and C++
* Windows Driver Frameworks (WDM, KMDF, UMDF)
* Windows Filtering Platform (WFP), minifilters, and ETW
* WinDbg and Sysinternals tools
* Slack, Zoom, and other remote collaboration tools

**Please NOTE:**

It is crucial that you complete the application form in full. As part of the application process, you will be required to record a video. If your application is successful, you will receive an email confirming next steps—the video is the first step of the interview process. If you do not record a video, we will not be able to consider you for ANY open roles.

We connect top talent with vetted employers, competitive pay, and real growth opportunities.

* Demonstrate extensive experience between eight and twelve years working with capital market solutions using Murex platforms with proven exposure to complex front office and back office implementation scenarios.

title: Senior Creatio Developer
description:
**Company Description**

SmartDev is an AI-powered software development company headquartered in Vietnam, part of the Verysell Group. We help global businesses deliver faster and build smarter — combining AI-driven development practices with deep expertise across **fintech, healthcare, retail, and enterprise technology**. Our team of engineers, architects, and AI specialists works across the full stack: from custom software and cloud solutions to generative AI, MLOps, and intelligent automation. At SmartDev, we believe that great architecture and AI-first thinking are a competitive advantage — and we build our teams accordingly.

The company is at a pivotal point in our journey: transitioning from a pure IT outsourcing provider to an **AI-enabled solutions partner**.

We have over 200 talented employees working both on-site and remote/hybrid at locations:

* Danang: 81 Quang Trung, Hai Chau 1 ward, Hai Chau District, Danang
* Hanoi: Zodiac building, 19 Duy Tan Street, Dich Vong Hau ward, Cau Giay District, Hanoi

  
**Job Description**

**About the role**

SmartDev is a Creatio implementation partner delivering enterprise **CRM** programmes for banks. The current engagement is an on-premises banking CRM with fifteen integration interfaces to core banking and surrounding systems, five promotion environments, and the bank's own change control over every release.

This is the technical core seat, and it is for someone already certified and already fluent in the platform. You write server-side logic and custom web services in versioned **Creatio** packages, build **Freedom UI components** where the standard palette is not enough, and own the integration contracts with the bank's systems.

Two constraints are not negotiable here: the product core is never modified, only supported extension points are used; and external systems never touch the Creatio database directly — everything goes through OData, DataService and governed APIs.

The third principle surprises most developers: you write code only where configuration genuinely cannot do the job. Your value on a low-code programme is measured as much by the code avoided as by the code shipped.

 **Qualifications**

**Requirements**

* **Active Creatio Developer certification**. Hard requirement for this opening; advanced-level certification is a significant plus.
* 3+ years developing on Creatio for real client implementations.
* **Strong C# / .NET**, plus working JavaScript and Angular for Freedom UI customization.
* Package architecture and versioning: file-system development backed by Git, dependency management, promotion across environments.
* Platform data access: EntitySchemaQuery, Entity, and the direct query classes, with the judgement to choose between them.
* Integration work you built yourself: REST/JSON, SOAP/XML, authentication, retries, idempotency, error handling.
* SQL Server performance: you can read an execution plan and fix a slow query rather than route around it.
* **English** at B2 or above.

**Strong advantages**

* **Banking** or fintech domain.
* On-premises deployment and clio CLI automation.
* Redis, Docker, CI/CD pipeline construction.
* RTL or Arabic interface work.
* Experience mentoring developers new to the platform — you would be one of the most experienced platform people in the team.

**What you will own**

* Server-side logic, custom services and Freedom UI components for assigned areas.
* Integration implementation against the bank's service bus and core systems.
* Code and configuration review across the team.
* Contribution to the practice's reusable accelerator set.

 **Additional Information**

**What we offer**

* A senior seat in a practice being built now, with influence over its engineering standards.
* The integration block — the technically hardest and commercially most valuable part of the scope.
* An international banking programme with direct client exposure.
* Continued funded certification on the Creatio track.
* Competitive compensation, hybrid working, and a senior engineering organisation with SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and PCI-DSS delivery credentials.

**Benefits**

* International working environment with AI-driven strategic direction.
* 20 days of annual leave – Hybrid working mode.
* Premium healthcare package with PVI and comprehensive annual health check-ups
* Competitive salary & 13th salary bonus
* Lunch allowance to fuel your productivity.
* Engaging company culture with fun activities
* Global collaboration – Work with both Vietnamese and international colleagues.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a high-caliber **Senior Software Engineer / Lead Design Engineer** to drive the development of next-generation railway subsystems. You will be responsible for designing and deploying critical electronic systems for Indian Railways, including **CVVRS**, **Remote Monitoring Systems**, and **Radio Communication sub-systems**.

This role demands a mix of embedded software expertise, networking protocol mastery, and deep familiarity with railway standards (RDSO, IEC, EN). As a lead engineer, you will own the software lifecycle, guide engineering teams, and ensure all systems are robust, scalable, and compliant.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **System Design & Development:** Design and develop software for critical railway technologies, including Camera systems, M-NVR, PoE Switches, Voice over IP (VoIP), Door Control Units, Water Level Indicators, OBCMS, and UHF Radio communication.
* **Protocol & Driver Implementation:** Write and optimize software drivers for image sensors, networking protocols, and industrial communication buses (CAN, MVB, RS485, and 4G/5G cellular transmission).
* **Project & Technical Leadership:** Plan, coordinate, and define engineering work packages for rolling stock projects. Drive end-to-end accountability for software deliverables while mentoring multi-functional teams.
* **Triage & Troubleshooting:** Lead complex debugging and triaging activities. Resolve hardware-software integration issues seamlessly alongside hardware and system engineers.
* **Backend Architecture:** Build and scale robust backend systems capable of processing and storing data from edge systems to multi-cluster cloud nodes.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

**Education**

* **B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech** in Computer Science Engineering, Electronics & Communication, or a related field.

**Experience**

* **Minimum 6 years** of experience in the design, development, and manufacturing of railway electronics or safety-critical embedded systems.
* **Minimum 2 years** of experience in a **Lead Engineer** or Project Driver capacity, handling multiple teams and projects simultaneously.

**Technical Expertise**

* **Embedded Networking & Hardware:** Deep understanding of Train Communication Networks (**TCN/VCU**). Hands-on experience with **CAN, MVB, RS485**, and wireless transmission over **4G/5G** networks.
* **Video & Image Processing:** Proven expertise in writing control applications for image sensors, video processing pipelines, and Video Management Software (VMS).
* **Core Fundamentals:** A deep understanding of computer architecture and networking infrastructure—ranging from localized desktop environments to distributed cloud nodes.

**Standards & Compliance**

* Strong working knowledge of current **RDSO specifications** and testing protocols.
* Demonstrated experience design-testing to comply with national and international railway standards (**IS / IEC / EN**), specifically:
* **IEC 60571 / EN 50155** (Railway applications - Electronic equipment used on rolling stock)
* **IEC 61375** (Train Communication Network)
* **IEC 61000-4-2, 3, 4, 5** (EMC/EMI immunity testing for ESD, Radiated RF, EFT, and Surge)

Pay: ₹680,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
