title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About Crunchyroll**
---------------------

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

**About the role**
------------------

We are hiring a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our India Operations and play a crucial role in our mission to establish a world-class data engineering team within the Center for Data and Insights (CDI). In this role, you’ll play a key part in building a cutting-edge, real-time data platform, designed to deliver insights at scale and power data-driven decision-making across our organization. Responsibilities will include collaborating with the data team and working on both backend microservices & frontend interfaces, crafting solutions that ensure data is processed, analyzed, and visualized in real time.

The ideal candidate will bring strong full-stack engineering expertise across modern frontend and backend technologies, with hands-on experience building scalable, secure, and cloud-native applications. You will leverage Java, Spring Boot, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps practices to deliver high-quality solutions that enable data-driven decision making for our business partners. This role requires a proactive, self-driven engineer who thrives in a collaborative environment, takes ownership from design through production, and balances technical excellence with business impact. By joining the CDI team, you will play a key role in shaping the data product application, building intuitive user experiences, scalable APIs, and robust platform capabilities that empower teams worldwide with timely, actionable insights. If you are passionate about solving complex problems, delivering exceptional user experiences, and driving continuous improvement across the full technology stack, we'd love to hear from you.

### **Core Areas of Responsibility**

* Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end features across the product, spanning React/Next.js frontend applications and Java Spring Boot backend services.
* Build secure, scalable REST APIs using OpenAPI-first design principles and implement robust authentication and authorization using Okta OIDC, OAuth2, and JWT-based security.
* Develop intuitive, accessible, and localized user experiences, including dashboards, analytics, data tables, and visualizations, ensuring WCAG-compliant implementations.
* Collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, UX designers, and stakeholders to deliver high-impact features and platform enhancements.
* Manage integrations with Databricks and other data platforms, optimizing API performance, database connectivity, and concurrent processing for large-scale analytics workloads.
* Implement comprehensive testing strategies across the stack, including unit, integration, API, and component testing, to ensure reliability and maintainability.
* Support cloud-native deployments using Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions, and GitOps practices, while maintaining observability through Datadog and production monitoring tools.
* Drive engineering excellence through code reviews, architectural discussions, performance optimization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**About You**
-------------

We get excited about candidates, like you, because...

* 8+ years of experience building and delivering modern full-stack applications using Java and React-based technologies.
* Strong expertise in Java 21, Spring Boot, REST API design, and secure application development using OAuth2, OIDC, and JWT authentication.
* Hands-on experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks, including state management, API integration, and component-driven development.
* Solid understanding of SQL-based data platforms and API-driven integrations, with experience optimizing application performance and scalability.
* Experience working with containerized and cloud-native environments, including Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms such as GCP and/or AWS.
* Proven ability to write high-quality, maintainable code supported by automated testing frameworks and engineering best practices.
* Strong collaboration, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience with Databricks, GitOps/Flux CD, observability platforms (Datadog), internationalization, or analytics applications is a plus.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

**About the Team**

title: Software Engineering Manager — Funded Development
description:
### **Description**

  

We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.  

  

This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD's core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Delivery \& stakeholder ownership** — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* **Hands\-on technical leadership \& design** — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* **Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence** — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* **AI\-assisted engineering** — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* **SE \+ SQE leadership** — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* **People management \& culture** — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

 **Essential Skills \& Experience*** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don't, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.

**Desirable Skills \& Experience*** Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).
* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading\-system delivery; background in kernel\-bypass / low\-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock\-free data structures.
* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.

  

### **Benefits**

  

***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India*** *We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* **Health \& Financial Security:**
	+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
* **Time Off \& Flexibility:**
	+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
	+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.
	+ One dedicated day per year for volunteering.
	+ Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development.
	+ An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years.
	+ Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal.
	+ Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents).
* **Work\-Life Support \& Resources:**
	+ Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment.
	+ Milestone anniversary bonuses.
* **Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks:**
	+ Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives.
* **Our Culture:**
Forward\-thinking, culture\-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.

Trading Technologies (www.tradingtechnologies.com) is a global capital markets platform services company providing market\-leading technology for the end\-to\-end trading operations of Tier 1 banks, brokerages, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) company delivers “multi\-X” solutions, with “X” representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. This multi\-X approach features trade execution services across futures and options, fixed income, foreign exchange (FX), and cryptocurrencies, augmented by solutions for data and analytics, including transaction cost analysis (TCA); quantitative trading; compliance and trade surveillance; clearing and post\-trade allocation; and infrastructure services. The award\-winning TT platform ecosystem also helps exchanges deliver innovative solutions to their market participants and technology companies to distribute their complementary offerings to Trading Technologies’ clients.  

Trading Technologies is backed by leading global investment firms Thoma Bravo, one of the world’s largest and most experienced software investors, and 7Ridge, a global growth equity firm focused on technology\-enabled businesses.
This investment supports Trading Technologies’ continued focus on product innovation, platform scalability, and long\-term growth for customers and partners worldwide.
  

*Trading Technologies (TT) is an equal\-opportunity employer. Equal employment has been, and continues to be, a required practice at the Company. Trading Technologies’ practice of equal employment opportunity is to recruit, hire, train, promote, and base all employment decisions on ability rather than race, color, religion, national origin, sex/gender orientation, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, parental status, veteran, or any other protected status. Additionally, TT participates in the E\-Verify Program for US offices.*  

  

### **About Trading Technologies**


Trading Technologies is a Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) technology platform provider to the global capital markets industry. The company’s award\-winning TT® platform connects to the world’s major international exchanges and liquidity venues in listed derivatives alongside a growing number of asset classes, including fixed income and cryptocurrencies. The TT platform delivers advanced tools for trade execution and order management, market data solutions, analytics, trade surveillance, risk management, and infrastructure services to the world’s leading sell\-side institutions, buy\-side firms, and exchanges. The company’s blue\-chip client base includes Tier 1 banks as well as brokers, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. title: Sr. Software Engineer B2
description:
Job Summary
  
This hybrid role for a senior software engineer demands strong experience in Kubernetes Python and SQL to design develop and optimize scalable enterprise applications that support critical merchandising workflows. The candidate will collaborate across functional teams during day shifts to deliver secure reliable systems that enhance operational efficiency and generate measurable business value for a global organization.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Design and implement robust backend services and data workflows using Python and SQL that enable scalable and maintainable enterprise applications supporting core business operations and decision making
  
Develop containerized applications and microservices with Kubernetes to ensure high availability automated scaling and resilient deployment of production workloads across hybrid environments
  
Optimize application performance and database queries by analyzing metrics profiling code and applying tuning techniques that improve response times and resource utilization for complex transactional systems
  
Create and maintain secure APIs and integration layers that connect internal platforms and third party systems to streamline data exchange and reduce manual operational overhead
  
Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical designs that align with strategic objectives and deliver measurable outcomes for the organization
  
Review and refine existing system architectures to identify enhancements in reliability observability and maintainability while reducing technical debt and operational risk
  
Implement automated testing and continuous integration practices that increase release quality and reduce regression issues across services built with Python and data layers powered by SQL
  
Monitor production systems and Kubernetes clusters using standardized tooling to proactively detect issues drive root cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective measures
  
Document system designs data models and deployment procedures in clear and accessible formats that support cross team collaboration and smooth onboarding for new engineering colleagues
  
Collaborate with data and analytics teams to ensure SQL data structures and pipelines are optimized for reporting forecasting and insights that support informed merchandising decisions when applicable
  
Drive adoption of secure coding practices and data protection standards within Python services and SQL data stores to safeguard sensitive information and comply with organizational policies
  
Coordinate work in a hybrid model and day shift schedule to support timely communication with distributed teams and maintain consistent progress against delivery milestones
  
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating new tools and practices in Kubernetes and Python ecosystems that increase engineering productivity and system reliability
  
  

Qualifications
  
Possess strong hands on experience designing and building production grade services using Python with a focus on clean code structure and reusable components for enterprise applications
  
Demonstrate advanced proficiency in SQL for modeling data structures writing complex queries and optimizing execution plans to support transactional and analytical workloads
  
Bring practical experience managing Kubernetes based deployments including configuration scaling and troubleshooting to ensure resilient and efficient application delivery
  
Show familiarity with hybrid work models and collaborative tools that enable effective coordination across onsite and remote team members during standard day shift schedules
  
Apply sound knowledge of software engineering principles including version control code review practices and automated testing to maintain high quality deliverables
  
Exhibit awareness of security best practices in application and data design to reduce vulnerabilities and protect organizational assets across services and databases
  
Preferably have exposure to merchandising domain processes such as assortment planning pricing or inventory optimization to better align technical solutions with business value
  
Display strong communication and problem solving abilities to analyze complex requirements propose pragmatic solutions and articulate technical decisions to diverse stakeholders

title: Custom Software Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Custom Software Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high\-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.
  

**Must have skills :** AWS Networking  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As a Custom Software Engineer, a typical day involves creating tailored software solutions by designing, coding, and improving various components within systems or applications. The role requires working with modern development frameworks and following agile methodologies to ensure the delivery of scalable and efficient software that meets unique business requirements. Collaboration with different teams and continuous refinement of software elements are integral parts of the daily workflow, fostering innovation and responsiveness to evolving project needs.  

We are looking for a Senior Network \& Kubernetes Migration Specialist (6–9 years experience) to lead and execute large\-scale AWS network and container platform migration initiatives. This role requires deep expertise in AWS networking, enterprise hybrid connectivity, and strong hands\-on experience with Amazon EKS from both infrastructure and application perspectives.  

  

1\. AWS Network Architecture \& Migration  

* Lead end\-to\-end migration of on\-premises and hybrid network environments to AWS.
* Design complex AWS networking architectures including multi\-account VPC strategy, subnet segmentation, routing, NAT, IGW, and load balancing.
* Architect and implement AWS Transit Gateway (hub\-and\-spoke, inter\-region, multi\-account connectivity).
* Design hybrid connectivity using AWS Direct Connect, Site\-to\-Site VPN, and BGP routing.
* Perform network segmentation aligned with zero\-trust principles.
* Lead migration risk assessment, rollback planning, and phased cutover strategies.
* Optimize network cost, latency, and high availability post migration.

  

2\. Security \& Governance  

* Define and enforce enterprise\-grade security policies using Security Groups, NACLs, AWS Network Firewall, and third\-party firewalls.
* Implement inspection VPC and centralized egress architectures.
* Collaborate with security teams on compliance and regulatory requirements.
* Implement guardrails using SCPs and IAM boundaries.

  

3\. Amazon EKS – Infrastructure Perspective  

* Design and operate production\-grade Amazon EKS clusters.
* Architect multi\-cluster and multi\-environment EKS strategies.
* Design cluster networking (CNI, IP management, pod density planning).
* Optimize VPC CNI, prefix delegation, and subnet sizing.
* Implement cluster autoscaling using Karpenter and Cluster Autoscaler.
* Manage node lifecycle, taints/tolerations, and capacity planning.
* Implement IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts).
* Upgrade and patch Kubernetes clusters with minimal downtime.

  

4\. Amazon EKS – Application Perspective  

* Support application teams in migrating workloads to Kubernetes.
* Design ingress strategies (ALB / NGINX Ingress).
* Optimize application networking (Services, Network Policies, DNS).
* Troubleshoot pod\-to\-pod and cross\-cluster communication issues.
* Implement scalability and resilience patterns (HPA, PDB, readiness/liveness probes).

  

5\. Platform Engineering \& Automation  

* Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform (modular approach).
* Implement GitOps workflows using Argo CD.
* Build CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
* Define policy\-as\-code using Kyverno.
* Develop automation scripts using Python or Go.

  

Required Skills \& Qualifications  

* 6–9 years of experience in AWS infrastructure, networking, and cloud\-migrations.
* Strong expertise in AWS VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, and VPN.
* Deep understanding of enterprise networking concepts (BGP, routing, firewalls, segmentation).
* Strong production experience with Amazon EKS (cluster design, scaling, networking optimization).
* Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes networking internals.
* Strong Terraform expertise (module design, remote state management).
* Experience implementing GitOps and CI/CD pipelines.
* Scripting experience with Python or Go.
* Strong troubleshooting and stakeholder communication skills.

  

15 years full time education

The Lead Software Engineer is responsible for contributing to the design, development, deployment, and operation of secure, scalable, and reliable software solutions.


The role provides technical leadership within an assigned product area or project, contributes to architectural and design decisions, and ensures that solutions comply with organizational engineering, quality, security, and operational standards.


The role is expected to lead complex projects, coordinate technical delivery across participating teams, mentor software engineers, and act as a key technical contact for project stakeholders.

**Your role**

* Lead the technical delivery of complex projects.

* Break technical solutions into implementable work packages and engineering tasks.
* Allocate or delegate technical activities within the team when appropriate.

* Strong presentation and demonstration skills, with the ability to communicate solution capabilities effectively to clients and stakeholders.
* Provide day\-to\-day technical guidance to software engineers.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level team members and support the development of their technical capabilities.
* Lead code reviews, design reviews, technical discussions, and engineering problem\-solving sessions.
* Delegate suitable technical activities and monitor their completion.
* Encourage team members to apply coding, security, testing, documentation, and DevOps standards.
* Promote knowledge sharing, collaborative problem\-solving, and continuous learning.
* Provide constructive feedback and identify development opportunities for team members.
* Facilitate collaboration among team members and other participating technical teams.
* Act as a technical escalation point within the assigned scope.
* Apply quality assurance practices throughout design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Define and enforce appropriate unit, integration, contract, API, security, performance, and regression testing expectations.
* Collaborate with QA engineers to develop test strategies and ensure adequate technical test coverage.
* Review code quality, test results, security findings, and release evidence.
* Ensure that defects are appropriately prioritized, investigated, resolved, and prevented from recurring.
* Conduct technical reviews to verify compliance with coding, architecture, security, and operational standards.
* Promote automation of repetitive testing and quality\-control activities.
* Lead technical design activities for an assigned product, application, service, or project area.
* Contribute to architectural decisions in collaboration with solution architects, enterprise architects, security specialists, and other technical stakeholders.
* Translate functional and non\-functional requirements into appropriate technical designs.
* Design scalable, maintainable, resilient, and secure software solutions.
* Design event\-driven and microservices\-based architectures where appropriate.
* Define service boundaries, integration patterns, data flows, and communication mechanisms.
* Apply API gateway patterns for routing, authentication, authorization, throttling, monitoring, and service abstraction.
* Evaluate technical options and document architectural decisions, assumptions, constraints, and trade\-offs.
* Ensure that technical designs are aligned with organizational standards and the approved architecture.
* Develop and maintain accurate technical documentation like Architecture and integration diagrams, Software development Plan, API specs etc.
* Ensure documentation is maintained throughout the product and project lifecycle.
* Communicate technical information effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Contribute directly to the implementation of complex and business\-critical software components.
* Apply specialist technical knowledge to investigate and resolve complex engineering problems.
* Develop high\-quality, secure, testable, maintainable, and reusable code.
* Establish coding practices and ensure that agreed engineering standards are consistently followed.
* Lead code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback to team members.
* Identify and address technical debt within the agreed product or project scope.
* Promote the use of suitable design patterns, reusable components, and engineering practices.
* Conduct proof\-of\-concept implementations when required to validate technical approaches.
* Support the integration of software components with internal systems, third\-party services, and cloud platforms.
* Define and implement the CI/CD approach for the assigned product or project area.
* Establish appropriate build, test, security scanning, approval, release, and deployment stages.
* Implement gated release processes and configure appropriate deployment approvals.
* Define and maintain development, testing, staging, pre\-production, and production deployment workflows.
* Implement automated quality checks within CI/CD pipelines.
* Define rollback, recovery, and release validation procedures.
* Monitor pipeline reliability and recommend improvements to release efficiency and deployment quality.
* Work with operations, platform, security, and infrastructure teams to resolve deployment\-related issues.
* Cloud Infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code:
* Design and provision Azure resources using Infrastructure as Code.
* Develop and maintain reusable Bicep or Terraform templates and modules.
* Apply source control, peer review, testing, and versioning practices to infrastructure code.
* Ensure consistency across environments through automated infrastructure provisioning.
* Apply appropriate Azure identity, networking, security, monitoring, and resource management practices.
* Support configuration management and secure handling of application secrets.
* Ensure that cloud resources follow organizational naming, tagging, access control, governance, and cost\-management standards.
* Security, Privacy, and Compliance:
* Incorporate security requirements throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Apply privacy\-by\-design and security\-by\-design principles to technical solutions.
* Ensure appropriate application of authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets management, logging, and audit controls.
* Integrate static analysis, dependency scanning, container scanning, and other security checks into engineering workflows.
* Ensure adherence to organizational security policies, development standards, and applicable industry or regulatory requirements.
* Track security findings and coordinate their timely remediation.
* Performance, Reliability, and Operational Support:
* Define and implement performance, scalability, availability, and reliability requirements.
* Analyse application behaviour, service dependencies, latency, throughput, resource utilization, and potential bottlenecks.
* Assess system performance and capacity and recommend appropriate improvements.
* Implement suitable caching, asynchronous processing, database optimization, connection management, and scaling strategies.
* Define appropriate monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and health\-check requirements.
* Contribute to the establishment of service\-level indicators and operational thresholds.
* Lead the technical investigation of complex incidents and recurring problems within the assigned product or project.
* Continuous Improvement and Technology Evaluation:
* Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt, improve performance, and streamline delivery; contribute to backlog grooming.
* Experience using approved AI\-assisted development tools for coding, code analysis, documentation, testing, troubleshooting, and engineering productivity.
* Understanding of the security, privacy, compliance, confidentiality, and intellectual property considerations associated with AI\-assisted engineering.
* Ability to identify appropriate AI use cases without compromising engineering quality or accountability.

* Strong knowledge of SQL, relational\-data modelling, query optimization, transactions, concurrency, and database\-performance considerations.
* Experience implementing repository, unit\-of\-work, specification, or other suitable data\-access patterns where appropriate.
* Ability to diagnose and resolve application and database performance issues, including inefficient queries and excessive data\-access operations.
* Understanding of secure data\-access practices, including parameterized queries, least\-privilege access, secure connection management, and protection against injection attacks.
* Solid experience in Authentication/Authorization (preferably Azure AD), Secure coding practices (input validation, secrets management) and Logging (Serilog, ILogger).
* Solid Experience working in Agile environments, using Azure DevOps (Boards, Repos, Pipelines) or equivalent tools for work tracking, source control, DevOps Pipelines and CI/CD.
* Solid experience working with Microsoft Azure Cloud (App Service, Functions, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Entra ID, etc) in real projects, including operational troubleshooting.
* Hands\-on Experience integrating APIs (REST) and handling security concerns (OAuth2/OIDC, tokens, scopes, roles).

**Preferred**

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**  

Role summary


The Staff Software Engineer (IC4\) on HR Service Delivery designs, builds, ships, and operates capabilities whose core behavior is model\-driven rather than explicitly authored: agentic and conversational experiences that interpret an employee's, manager's, or HR agent's intent, reason over employee profile, case, catalog, policy, and knowledge context, invoke tools, and act on the user's behalf across the employee lifecycle.


This is not a machine learning or AI research role; the engineer does not train foundation models. It is also distinct from traditional full\-stack engineering, where systems follow deterministic logic rather than selecting execution paths at runtime. Two consequences shape the work. First, the most important logic often lives in natural language: instructions, prompts, tool descriptions, guardrails, escalation rules, all of which must be engineered, versioned, and reviewed with the same discipline as code. Second, because behavior is probabilistic, correctness is established by measuring behavior at scale rather than by asserting fixed outputs, making automated evaluation a first\-class engineering activity rather than a quality\-assurance afterthought.


HR sharpens both points along two independent axes.

**Accuracy.** An agent answering on payroll, benefits, leave, or a lifecycle event touches statutory entitlement, jurisdiction\-specific policy, and an employee's pay. A confidently wrong output is not a bad answer; it is a missed enrollment window or an incorrect leave balance acted on in good faith.

**Audience.** HR data is among the most sensitive on the platform, and correctness of content is not sufficient. An answer grounded in a record or knowledge article the requestor is not entitled to read is a data exposure even when every fact in it is true, and manager\-scope and employee\-scope views of the same question have different correct answers. Access boundaries have to be enforced in the retrieval and tool layer rather than requested of the model.


At IC4 the engineer owns AI design decisions across the domain, not within a single feature, and owns the correctness of what ships whether a person or an agent produced it.


What you do Build AI\-native capability across the employee lifecycle


Design and ship features built around agentic behavior — intent interpretation, multi\-step reasoning, tool invocation, and action on the user's behalf — together with the data models, integrations, and channels that make them usable in production. In HRSD this spans guided service selection and intake, natural\-language case creation and enrichment, conversational case status and in\-flight change, tiered resolution of payroll and benefits inquiries, case triage, routing, and deflection, eligibility and entitlement inquiry, and agent\-driven execution of onboarding, transfer, and offboarding lifecycle events.


Design AI\-driven autonomous workflows


Decompose HR processes into the steps and decision points an agent can execute: determining where autonomy is appropriate, where a checkpoint with a person is required, and how exceptions, retries, and hand\-back are handled. Anything that changes pay, employment status, or a restricted record, and anything touching employee relations or investigation, needs a human decision point by construction. The design must make that distinction structural rather than advisory.


Author and maintain agentic instructions as engineering artifacts


Write, structure, and version the system instructions, role definitions, tool descriptions, guardrails, and escalation paths that govern agent behavior in the domain, under code review, source control, and regression coverage. Own the shared instruction and tool\-description surface that adjacent teams build against. Because HRSD ships as product, customers configure, extend, and override that surface on their own instances: treat it as public API, with upgrade\-safe extension points and versioning discipline to match.


Build automated evaluation and test non\-deterministic behavior


Design and operate the evaluation that makes change safe: golden datasets, multi\-turn conversation suites, model\-as\-judge scoring calibrated to human review, CI gates, and drift detection, plus adversarial, jailbreak, grounding, and tool\-selection testing. Extend that coverage to the HR\-specific failure classes — access\-boundary violations in retrieval and citation, PII leakage across scopes, and jurisdictional and policy\-variant correctness — and keep evaluation meaningful across customer configurations rather than against a single reference dataset. Own the resolution, containment, and quality metrics the domain is measured on, including whether they are instrumented correctly in the first place.


Design conversational experiences across channels


Build experiences that hold context across turns, hand off cleanly between automated and live HR agents, and behave consistently across employee\-facing portals, chat shells, workplace messaging clients, agent workspace, and voice — accounting for what voice imposes: latency budgets, barge\-in, speech recognition error on names and plan terminology, disambiguation, and explicit confirmation before consequential actions.


Specify precisely and direct AI coding agents


Convert requirements into testable specifications with explicit scope, constraints, non\-goals, and acceptance criteria; decompose work into agent\-sized tasks; supervise several workstreams in parallel; and review agent output for correctness, spec adherence, security, and maintainability. You own the result regardless of what produced it.


Own quality, safety, and reliability in production


Monitor conversation quality, containment, hallucination rate, tool\-selection error, and unsafe or unauthorized action. Defend against prompt injection and data leakage across integration surfaces, including the paths where user\-supplied content — case notes, inbound email, attachments, authored knowledge — enters agent context. Maintain reasoning\-trace observability and model rollback mechanisms, and feed production failures back into specifications and evaluation sets. Because HR conversation content is itself restricted, design that observability to be diagnosable without exposing what was said. Lead root\-cause analysis when agentic behavior deviates from intent, and hold the line between a genuine model failure and a platform or configuration failure presenting as one.


Ground it in solid full\-stack delivery


Build the application, APIs, data models, and integrations around these capabilities: front\-end experiences for employees, managers, and HR agents, server\-side logic, and the connections to HCM, payroll, benefits, identity, knowledge, and the adjacent service domains HR cases cross into — with the CI/CD, observability, and upgrade\-safe extensibility expected of production software.


Collaborate across product, design, and engineering


Partner with product managers, designers, conversation designers, HR domain and compliance partners, and engineers to define success criteria and communicate capability and risk clearly. Mentor IC1 to IC3 engineers, and raise the team's practices around instruction authoring, evaluation, and accountable agent use.

 **Qualifications** **Required experience and skills**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 9\+ years software engineering experience (backend, frontend, or full stack)


 Strong JavaScript/Node.js, React and API integration skills


 Automated testing (unit \+ integration) and CI/CD pipeline experience


 Solid understanding of data modelling and query optimization

* Agentic delivery experience:


 Hands\-on experience with AI/GenAI or ML\-driven features (LLM prompting, NLU,  

 classification models, or similar)


 Hands\-on experience with LLM\-integrated features: prompt design, context injection, output tuning, guardrails.


 Experience with NLU/intent classification or conversational AI systems


 Familiarity with ML\-driven automation (classification, clustering, recommendation  

 systems)

* Production AI integration. Experience integrating large language model APIs and retrieval\-grounded features, including agent orchestration, tool and function calling, and structured output enforcement.
* Applied machine learning literacy. A working command of the concepts that govern how these systems behave — evaluation, embeddings, and the probabilistic output and failure modes of modern models — sufficient to reason about, debug, and verify model\-driven behaviour in production.
* Accountable use of AI coding agents. Current, effective use of AI coding assistants and agents with evidence of accountable delivery: precise specification, critical review of generated output, and verification harnesses.
* Operational experience. Hands\-on CI/CD, containerized workloads, and observability experience, plus direct on\-call and incident\-command experience with customer\-facing systems.
* Mentorship. Demonstrated mentorship of less\-experienced engineers and a record of raising quality through code review.
* Education. Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees are a plus but not a substitute for a record of shipping reliable AI\-native applications.

**Preferred experience**

* HR domain depth. HR case management, the employee lifecycle, or payroll, benefits, leave, and absence, at a depth sufficient to challenge a requirement rather than only implement it — including why the same policy question resolves differently by jurisdiction, employment type, or plan year.
* HCM and downstream integration. Integration with core HR, payroll, and benefits systems of record, including the reconciliation and eventual\-consistency problems that come with treating an external system as the authority on employment data.
* Extensible product engineering. Building capability that customers configure, extend, and override on their own instances, where instruction and tool surfaces are versioned contracts rather than internal implementation.
* Evaluation and observability tooling. Evaluation frameworks, prompt and instruction management tooling, tracing for model\-driven applications, and analysis of production transcripts at scale, particularly where transcript content is itself access\-restricted.
* Conversational channel breadth. Employee self\-service portals, virtual agent or chat shells, workplace messaging clients, and voice, including handoff between automated and live agents.
* Conversation design partnership. Working alongside conversation or content designers on dialogue flow, tone, and error\-recovery design — with attention to how an HR answer is worded when the subject is the employee's own pay, health coverage, or employment status.
* Forward deployed delivery. Building against a customer's data, integrations, and channels, and tuning instructions and evaluation sets in their environment.
* Now Platform depth. Scoped applications, ACLs and platform security rules, Flow Designer, UI Builder, Automated Test Framework, and upgrade\-safe extension patterns.

 **Additional Information** **Work Personas**


We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third\-party service.

In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.
